verses.hebrew: אִישׁ הָיָה בְאֶרֶץ־עוּץ אִיּוֹב שְׁמוֹ וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ הַהוּא תָּם וְיָשָׁר וִירֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע׃
verses.english: There was a man in the land of ῾Uż, whose name was Iyyov, and that man was perfect and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לוֹ שִׁבְעָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת׃
verses.english: And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְנֵהוּ שִׁבְעַת אַלְפֵי־צֹאן וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אַלְפֵי גְמַלִּים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת צֶמֶד־בָּקָר וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֲתוֹנוֹת וַעֲבֻדָּה רַבָּה מְאֹד וַיְהִי הָאִישׁ הַהוּא גָּדוֹל מִכָּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם׃
verses.english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and very many servants; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

verses.hebrew: וְהָלְכוּ בָנָיו וְעָשׂוּ מִשְׁתֶּה בֵּית אִישׁ יוֹמוֹ וְשָׁלְחוּ וְקָרְאוּ לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת אחיתיהם [אַחְיוֹתֵיהֶם] לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת עִמָּהֶם׃
verses.english: And his sons used to go and feast in the house of each one on his day; and they used to send and call for their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי הִקִּיפוּ יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיִּשְׁלַח אִיּוֹב וַיְקַדְּשֵׁם וְהִשְׁכִּים בַּבֹּקֶר וְהֶעֱלָה עֹלוֹת מִסְפַּר כֻּלָּם כִּי אָמַר אִיּוֹב אוּלַי חָטְאוּ בָנַי וּבֵרֲכוּ אֱלֹהִים בִּלְבָבָם כָּכָה יַעֲשֶׂה אִיּוֹב כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: And when the days of their feasting were gone about, Iyyov sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Iyyov said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and despised God in their hearts. Thus Iyyov did continually.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה וַיָּבוֹא גַם־הַשָּׂטָן בְּתוֹכָם׃
verses.english: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and the adversary came also among them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן מֵאַיִן תָּבֹא וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר מִשּׁוּט בָּאָרֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, From where dost thou come? Then the adversary answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הֲשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ עַל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ תָּם וְיָשָׁר יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, Hast thou considered my servant Iyyov, that there is none like him on earth, a perfect and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַחִנָּם יָרֵא אִיּוֹב אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Then the adversary answered the Lord, and said, Does Iyyov fear God for nought?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־את [אַתָּה] שַׂכְתָּ בַעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד־בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו בֵּרַכְתָּ וּמִקְנֵהוּ פָּרַץ בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Hast Thou not made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he has on every side? Thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁלַח־נָא יָדְךָ וְגַע בְּכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ אִם־לֹא עַל־פָּנֶיךָ יְבָרֲכֶךָּ׃
verses.english: But now put forth Thy hand, and touch all that he has, and he will curse Thee to Thy face.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הִנֵּה כָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בְּיָדֶךָ רַק אֵלָיו אַל־תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וַיֵּצֵא הַשָּׂטָן מֵעִם פְּנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, Behold, all that he has is in thy power; only upon himself do not put forth thy hand. So the adversary went out from the presence of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וּבָנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים יַיִן בְּבֵית אֲחִיהֶם הַבְּכוֹר׃
verses.english: Now there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר הַבָּקָר הָיוּ חֹרְשׁוֹת וְהָאֲתֹנוֹת רֹעוֹת עַל־יְדֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and there came a messenger to Iyyov, and said, The oxen were ploughing, and the asses were feeding beside them:

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל שְׁבָא וַתִּקָּחֵם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים הִכּוּ לְפִי־חָרֶב וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃
verses.english: and men of Sheva fell upon them, and took them away; and slew the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.hebrew: עוֹד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר אֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים נָפְלָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתִּבְעַר בַּצֹּאן וּבַנְּעָרִים וַתֹּאכְלֵם וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃
verses.english: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God has fallen from heaven, and has burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.hebrew: עוֹד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר כַּשְׂדִּים שָׂמוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיִּקָּחוּם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים הִכּוּ לְפִי־חָרֶב וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃
verses.english: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Kasdim formed three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, and have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.hebrew: עַד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנוֹתֶיךָ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים יַיִן בְּבֵית אֲחִיהֶם הַבְּכוֹר׃
verses.english: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה רוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה בָּאָה מֵעֵבֶר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיִּגַּע בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַבַּיִת וַיִּפֹּל עַל־הַנְּעָרִים וַיָּמוּתוּ וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃
verses.english: and, behold, there came a great wind from across the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם אִיּוֹב וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־מְעִלוֹ וַיָּגָז אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov arose, and rent his coat, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and prostrated himself,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עָרֹם יצתי [יָצָאתִי] מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי וְעָרֹם אָשׁוּב שָׁמָה יְהוָה נָתַן וַיהוָה לָקָח יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ׃
verses.english: and said, Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked I shall return there: the Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־זֹאת לֹא־חָטָא אִיּוֹב וְלֹא־נָתַן תִּפְלָה לֵאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: In all this Iyyov sinned not, nor did he lay reproach on God.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה וַיָּבוֹא גַם־הַשָּׂטָן בְּתֹכָם לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and the adversary came also among them to present himself before the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבֹא וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר מִשֻּׁט בָּאָרֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, From where dost thou come? And the adversary answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הֲשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ תָּם וְיָשָׁר יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע וְעֹדֶנּוּ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתוֹ וַתְּסִיתֵנִי בוֹ לְבַלְּעוֹ חִנָּם׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, Hast thou considered my servant Iyyov, that there is none like him on earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears God and turns away from evil? and still he holds fast to his integrity, although thou didst move me against him, to destroy him without cause.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר עוֹר בְּעַד־עוֹר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לָאִישׁ יִתֵּן בְּעַד נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: And the adversary answered the Lord, and said, Skin covers skin! for all that a man has he will give for his life.

verses.hebrew: אוּלָם שְׁלַח־נָא יָדְךָ וְגַע אֶל־עַצְמוֹ וְאֶל־בְּשָׂרוֹ אִם־לֹא אֶל־פָּנֶיךָ יְבָרֲכֶךָּ׃
verses.english: But put forth thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse Thee to Thy face.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הִנּוֹ בְיָדֶךָ אַךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ שְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: And the Lord said to the adversary, Behold, he is in thy hand; but save his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַשָּׂטָן מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־אִיּוֹב בִּשְׁחִין רָע מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ עד [וְעַד] קָדְקֳדוֹ׃
verses.english: So the adversary went forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Iyyov with vile sores from the sole of his foot to his crown.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח־לוֹ חֶרֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵד בּוֹ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ־הָאֵפֶר׃
verses.english: And he took him a potsherd with which to scrape himself; and he sat down among the ashes.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ עֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתֶךָ בָּרֵךְ אֱלֹהִים וָמֻת׃
verses.english: Then his wife said to him, Dost thou still retain thy integrity? curse God, and die.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ כְּדַבֵּר אַחַת הַנְּבָלוֹת תְּדַבֵּרִי גַּם אֶת־הַטּוֹב נְקַבֵּל מֵאֵת הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֶת־הָרָע לֹא נְקַבֵּל בְּכָל־זֹאת לֹא־חָטָא אִיּוֹב בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃
verses.english: But he said to her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaks. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this Iyyov did not sin with his lips.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת רֵעֵי אִיּוֹב אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַבָּאָה עָלָיו וַיָּבֹאוּ אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי וְצוֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ יַחְדָּו לָבוֹא לָנוּד־לוֹ וּלְנַחֲמוֹ׃
verses.english: Now when Iyyov’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Elifaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuĥite, and Żofar the Na῾amatite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרָחוֹק וְלֹא הִכִּירֻהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיִּקְרְעוּ אִישׁ מְעִלוֹ וַיִּזְרְקוּ עָפָר עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶם הַשָּׁמָיְמָה׃
verses.english: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his coat, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אִתּוֹ לָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת לֵילוֹת וְאֵין־דֹּבֵר אֵלָיו דָּבָר כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־גָדַל הַכְּאֵב מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And they sat down with him on the ground for seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word to him: for they saw that his suffering was very great.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי־כֵן פָּתַח אִיּוֹב אֶת־פִּיהוּ וַיְקַלֵּל אֶת־יוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: After this Iyyov opened his mouth, and cursed his day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: And Iyyov spoke, and said,

verses.hebrew: יֹאבַד יוֹם אִוָּלֶד בּוֹ וְהַלַּיְלָה אָמַר הֹרָה גָבֶר׃
verses.english: Oh that the day had perished wherein I was born, and the night which said, There is a man child conceived.

verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַהוּא יְהִי חֹשֶׁךְ אַל־יִדְרְשֵׁהוּ אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְאַל־תּוֹפַע עָלָיו נְהָרָה׃
verses.english: Let that day be darkness; let not God inquire after it from above, nor let the light shine upon it.

verses.hebrew: יִגְאָלֻהוּ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן־עָלָיו עֲנָנָה יְבַעֲתֻהוּ כִּמְרִירֵי יוֹם׃
verses.english: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

verses.hebrew: הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא יִקָּחֵהוּ אֹפֶל אַל־יִחַדְּ בִּימֵי שָׁנָה בְּמִסְפַּר יְרָחִים אַל־יָבֹא׃
verses.english: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not rejoice among the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא יְהִי גַלְמוּד אַל־תָּבֹא רְנָנָה בוֹ׃
verses.english: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful cry be heard in it.

verses.hebrew: יִקְּבֻהוּ אֹרְרֵי־יוֹם הָעֲתִידִים עֹרֵר לִוְיָתָן׃
verses.english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to arouse livyatan.

verses.hebrew: יֶחְשְׁכוּ כּוֹכְבֵי נִשְׁפּוֹ יְקַו־לְאוֹר וָאַיִן וְאַל־יִרְאֶה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר׃
verses.english: Let the stars of its dusk be dark; let it look for light, but have none; and let it not see the eyelids of the morn:

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא סָגַר דַּלְתֵי בִטְנִי וַיַּסְתֵּר עָמָל מֵעֵינָי׃
verses.english: because it did not shut up the doors of my mother’s womb nor hide trouble from my eyes.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה לֹּא מֵרֶחֶם אָמוּת מִבֶּטֶן יָצָאתִי וְאֶגְוָע׃
verses.english: Why did I not die from the womb? why did I not perish when I came out of the belly?

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ קִדְּמוּנִי בִרְכָּיִם וּמַה־שָּׁדַיִם כִּי אִינָק׃
verses.english: Why did the knees receive me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאֶשְׁקוֹט יָשַׁנְתִּי אָז יָנוּחַ לִי׃
verses.english: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

verses.hebrew: עִם־מְלָכִים וְיֹעֲצֵי אָרֶץ הַבֹּנִים חֳרָבוֹת לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: with kings and counsellors of the earth, who built desolate places for themselves;

verses.hebrew: אוֹ עִם־שָׂרִים זָהָב לָהֶם הַמְמַלְאִים בָּתֵּיהֶם כָּסֶף׃
verses.english: or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

verses.hebrew: אוֹ כְנֵפֶל טָמוּן לֹא אֶהְיֶה כְּעֹלְלִים לֹא־רָאוּ אוֹר׃
verses.english: or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants that never saw light.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם רְשָׁעִים חָדְלוּ רֹגֶז וְשָׁם יָנוּחוּ יְגִיעֵי כֹחַ׃
verses.english: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary are at rest.

verses.hebrew: יַחַד אֲסִירִים שַׁאֲנָנוּ לֹא שָׁמְעוּ קוֹל נֹגֵשׂ׃
verses.english: There the prisoners are at ease together; they hear not the voice of the slave driver.

verses.hebrew: קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל שָׁם הוּא וְעֶבֶד חָפְשִׁי מֵאֲדֹנָיו׃
verses.english: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יִתֵּן לְעָמֵל אוֹר וְחַיִּים לְמָרֵי נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Why is light given to him that is in misery, and life to the bitter in soul;

verses.hebrew: הַמְחַכִּים לַמָּוֶת וְאֵינֶנּוּ וַיַּחְפְּרֻהוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִים׃
verses.english: who long for death, but it does not come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures;

verses.hebrew: הַשְּׂמֵחִים אֱלֵי־גִיל יָשִׂישׂוּ כִּי יִמְצְאוּ־קָבֶר׃
verses.english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find a grave?

verses.hebrew: לְגֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־דַּרְכּוֹ נִסְתָּרָה וַיָּסֶךְ אֱלוֹהַּ בַּעֲדוֹ׃
verses.english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, and from whom God has screened himself?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִפְנֵי לַחְמִי אַנְחָתִי תָבֹא וַיִּתְּכוּ כַמַּיִם שַׁאֲגֹתָי׃
verses.english: For my sighing comes before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

verses.hebrew: כִּי פַחַד פָּחַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵנִי וַאֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי יָבֹא לִי׃
verses.english: For the thing which I had feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come to me.

verses.hebrew: לֹא שָׁלַוְתִּי וְלֹא שָׁקַטְתִּי וְלֹא־נָחְתִּי וַיָּבֹא רֹגֶז׃
verses.english: I had no repose, nor had I rest, nor was I quiet; yet trouble came.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Elifaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.hebrew: הֲנִסָּה דָבָר אֵלֶיךָ תִּלְאֶה וַעְצֹר בְּמִלִּין מִי יוּכָל׃
verses.english: If one ventures a word to thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יִסַּרְתָּ רַבִּים וְיָדַיִם רָפוֹת תְּחַזֵּק׃
verses.english: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

verses.hebrew: כּוֹשֵׁל יְקִימוּן מִלֶּיךָ וּבִרְכַּיִם כֹּרְעוֹת תְּאַמֵּץ׃
verses.english: Thy words have upheld him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֵלֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶא תִּגַּע עָדֶיךָ וַתִּבָּהֵל׃
verses.english: But now it is come upon thee, and thou art weary; it touches thee, and thou art troubled.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יִרְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶךָ תִּקְוָתְךָ וְתֹם דְּרָכֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Is not thy fear of God thy confidence, and thy hope the integrity of thy ways?

verses.hebrew: זְכָר־נָא מִי הוּא נָקִי אָבָד וְאֵיפֹה יְשָׁרִים נִכְחָדוּ׃
verses.english: Recall, now, who that was innocent ever perished? or where were the upright cut off?

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי חֹרְשֵׁי אָוֶן וְזֹרְעֵי עָמָל יִקְצְרֻהוּ׃
verses.english: Even as I have seen, they that plough iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

verses.hebrew: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֱלוֹהַ יֹאבֵדוּ וּמֵרוּחַ אַפּוֹ יִכְלוּ׃
verses.english: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of his anger they are consumed.

verses.hebrew: שַׁאֲגַת אַרְיֵה וְקוֹל שָׁחַל וְשִׁנֵּי כְפִירִים נִתָּעוּ׃
verses.english: The roar of the lion, and the cry of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

verses.hebrew: לַיִשׁ אֹבֵד מִבְּלִי־טָרֶף וּבְנֵי לָבִיא יִתְפָּרָדוּ׃
verses.english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלַי דָּבָר יְגֻנָּב וַתִּקַּח אָזְנִי שֵׁמֶץ מֶנְהוּ׃
verses.english: Now a word came stealthily to me, and my ear took fright at it.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנוֹת לָיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים׃
verses.english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls,

verses.hebrew: פַּחַד קְרָאַנִי וּרְעָדָה וְרֹב עַצְמוֹתַי הִפְחִיד׃
verses.english: fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ עַל־פָּנַי יַחֲלֹף תְּסַמֵּר שַׂעֲרַת בְּשָׂרִי׃
verses.english: Then a spirit passed before my face; it made the hair of my flesh to bristle up:

verses.hebrew: יַעֲמֹד וְלֹא־אַכִּיר מַרְאֵהוּ תְּמוּנָה לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל אֶשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: it stood still, but I could not discern its form: a shape was before my eyes: there was silence, and I heard a voice saying,

verses.hebrew: הַאֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱלוֹהַ יִצְדָּק אִם מֵעֹשֵׂהוּ יִטְהַר־גָּבֶר׃
verses.english: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

verses.hebrew: הֵן בַּעֲבָדָיו לֹא יַאֲמִין וּבְמַלְאָכָיו יָשִׂים תָּהֳלָה׃
verses.english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants; and his angels he charges with folly:

verses.hebrew: אַף שֹׁכְנֵי בָתֵּי־חֹמֶר אֲשֶׁר־בֶּעָפָר יְסוֹדָם יְדַכְּאוּם לִפְנֵי־עָשׁ׃
verses.english: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth?

verses.hebrew: מִבֹּקֶר לָעֶרֶב יֻכַּתּוּ מִבְּלִי מֵשִׂים לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵדוּ׃
verses.english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed: they perish for ever without anyone paying heed.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־נִסַּע יִתְרָם בָּם יָמוּתוּ וְלֹא בְחָכְמָה׃
verses.english: Is not their excellency which was in them gone away? they die; for they are without wisdom.

verses.hebrew: קְרָא־נָא הֲיֵשׁ עוֹנֶךָּ וְאֶל־מִי מִקְּדֹשִׁים תִּפְנֶה׃
verses.english: Call now, is there any that will answer thee? and to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֶאֱוִיל יַהֲרָג־כָּעַשׂ וּפֹתֶה תָּמִית קִנְאָה׃
verses.english: For anger kills the foolish man, and envy slays the simpleton.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־רָאִיתִי אֱוִיל מַשְׁרִישׁ וָאֶקּוֹב נָוֵהוּ פִתְאֹם׃
verses.english: I have seen the foolish taking root: and suddenly I cursed his dwelling, saying,

verses.hebrew: יִרְחֲקוּ בָנָיו מִיֶּשַׁע וְיִדַּכְּאוּ בַשַּׁעַר וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
verses.english: Let his children be far from safety, and let them be crushed in the gate, with none to rescue them.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר קְצִירוֹ רָעֵב יֹאכֵל וְאֶל־מִצִּנִּים יִקָּחֵהוּ וְשָׁאַף צַמִּים חֵילָם׃
verses.english: Let the hungry eat up his harvest, and take it to the thorn hedges, and let the thirsty swallow up their substance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יֵצֵא מֵעָפָר אָוֶן וּמֵאֲדָמָה לֹא־יִצְמַח עָמָל׃
verses.english: For affliction does not come out of the dust, nor does trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָדָם לְעָמָל יוּלָּד וּבְנֵי־רֶשֶׁף יַגְבִּיהוּ עוּף׃
verses.english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.hebrew: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶדְרֹשׁ אֶל־אֵל וְאֶל־אֱלֹהִים אָשִׂים דִּבְרָתִי׃
verses.english: But I would seek to God, and to God I would commit my cause:

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְאֵין חֵקֶר נִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
verses.english: who does great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

verses.hebrew: הַנֹּתֵן מָטָר עַל־פְּנֵי־אָרֶץ וְשֹׁלֵחַ מַיִם עַל־פְּנֵי חוּצוֹת׃
verses.english: who gives rain upon the earth, and sends water upon the fields:

verses.hebrew: לָשׂוּם שְׁפָלִים לְמָרוֹם וְקֹדְרִים שָׂגְבוּ יֶשַׁע׃
verses.english: to set up on high those who are low; that those who mourn may be exalted to safety.

verses.hebrew: מֵפֵר מַחְשְׁבוֹת עֲרוּמִים וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂינָה יְדֵיהֶם תּוּשִׁיָּה׃
verses.english: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their policy.

verses.hebrew: לֹכֵד חֲכָמִים בְּעָרְמָם וַעֲצַת נִפְתָּלִים נִמְהָרָה׃
verses.english: He catches the wise in their own craftiness; and the rash counsel of the crooked.

verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־חֹשֶׁךְ וְכַלַּיְלָה יְמַשְׁשׁוּ בַצָּהֳרָיִם׃
verses.english: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּשַׁע מֵחֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶם וּמִיַּד חָזָק אֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: But he saves from the sword, from the enemy’s mouth; and the poor from the hand of the mighty.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי לַדַּל תִּקְוָה וְעֹלָתָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃
verses.english: So the poor has hope, and iniquity stops her mouth.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶנּוּ אֱלוֹהַּ וּמוּסַר שַׁדַּי אַל־תִּמְאָס׃
verses.english: Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects: therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty:

verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא יַכְאִיב וְיֶחְבָּשׁ יִמְחַץ וידו [וְיָדָיו] תִּרְפֶּינָה׃
verses.english: for he makes sore, and binds up: he wounds, but his hands make whole.

verses.hebrew: בְּשֵׁשׁ צָרוֹת יַצִּילֶךָּ וּבְשֶׁבַע לֹא־יִגַּע בְּךָ רָע׃
verses.english: He will deliver thee in six troubles: and in seven no evil shall touch thee.

verses.hebrew: בְּרָעָב פָּדְךָ מִמָּוֶת וּבְמִלְחָמָה מִידֵי חָרֶב׃
verses.english: In famine he will redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.hebrew: בְּשׁוֹט לָשׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵא וְלֹא־תִירָא מִשֹּׁד כִּי יָבוֹא׃
verses.english: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: nor shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it comes.

verses.hebrew: לְשֹׁד וּלְכָפָן תִּשְׂחָק וּמֵחַיַּת הָאָרֶץ אַל־תִּירָא׃
verses.english: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: nor shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עִם־אַבְנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְרִיתֶךָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה הָשְׁלְמָה־לָךְ׃
verses.english: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the wild beasts shall be at peace with thee.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־שָׁלוֹם אָהֳלֶךָ וּפָקַדְתָּ נָוְךָ וְלֹא תֶחֱטָא׃
verses.english: And thou shalt know that thy tent is at peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt miss nothing.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־רַב זַרְעֶךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֶיךָ כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thy offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא בְכֶלַח אֱלֵי־קָבֶר כַּעֲלוֹת גָּדִישׁ בְּעִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Thou shalt come to thy grave with a rich harvest, like a full sheaf of corn which comes up in its season.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־זֹאת חֲקַרְנוּהָ כֶּן־הִיא שְׁמָעֶנָּה וְאַתָּה דַע־לָךְ׃
verses.english: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know it, for thy good.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: And Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: לוּ שָׁקוֹל יִשָּׁקֵל כַּעְשִׂי והיתי [וְהַוָּתִי] בְּמֹאזְנַיִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָחַד׃
verses.english: Oh that my vexation were thoroughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה מֵחוֹל יַמִּים יִכְבָּד עַל־כֵּן דְּבָרַי לָעוּ׃
verses.english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are stammering.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חִצֵּי שַׁדַּי עִמָּדִי אֲשֶׁר חֲמָתָם שֹׁתָה רוּחִי בִּעוּתֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעַרְכוּנִי׃
verses.english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison of which my spirit drinks up: the terrors of God array themselves against me.

verses.hebrew: הֲיִנְהַק־פֶּרֶא עֲלֵי־דֶשֶׁא אִם יִגְעֶה־שּׁוֹר עַל־בְּלִילוֹ׃
verses.english: Does the wild ass bray when he has grass? or does the ox low over his fodder?

verses.hebrew: הֲיֵאָכֵל תָּפֵל מִבְּלִי־מֶלַח אִם־יֶשׁ־טַעַם בְּרִיר חַלָּמוּת׃
verses.english: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

verses.hebrew: מֵאֲנָה לִנְגּוֹעַ נַפְשִׁי הֵמָּה כִּדְוֵי לַחְמִי׃
verses.english: My soul refuses to touch them; they are to me as loathsome food.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן תָּבוֹא שֶׁאֱלָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ׃
verses.english: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

verses.hebrew: וְיֹאֵל אֱלוֹהַּ וִידַכְּאֵנִי יַתֵּר יָדוֹ וִיבַצְּעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Even that it would please God to trample on me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

verses.hebrew: וּתְהִי עוֹד נֶחָמָתִי וַאֲסַלְּדָה בְחִילָה לֹא יַחְמוֹל כִּי־לֹא כִחַדְתִּי אִמְרֵי קָדוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would exalt in pain: let him not spare; for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

verses.hebrew: מַה־כֹּחִי כִי־אֲיַחֵל וּמַה־קִּצִּי כִּי־אַאֲרִיךְ נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is my end, that I should be patient?

verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּחַ אֲבָנִים כֹּחִי אִם־בְּשָׂרִי נָחוּשׁ׃
verses.english: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

verses.hebrew: הַאִם אֵין עֶזְרָתִי בִי וְתֻשִׁיָּה נִדְּחָה מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Is not my help in me? and is sound policy driven quite from me?

verses.hebrew: לַמָּס מֵרֵעֵהוּ חָסֶד וְיִרְאַת שַׁדַּי יַעֲזוֹב׃
verses.english: To him that is afflicted love is due from his friend; or else he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

verses.hebrew: אַחַי בָּגְדוּ כְמוֹ־נָחַל כַּאֲפִיק נְחָלִים יַעֲבֹרוּ׃
verses.english: My brethren have dealt deceitfully like a wadi, and like the water courses which disappear;

verses.hebrew: הַקֹּדְרִים מִנִּי־קָרַח עָלֵימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־שָׁלֶג׃
verses.english: which are black by reason of the ice, and in which the snow dissolves:

verses.hebrew: בְּעֵת יְזֹרְבוּ נִצְמָתוּ בְּחֻמּוֹ נִדְעֲכוּ מִמְּקוֹמָם׃
verses.english: when the time comes they grow warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

verses.hebrew: יִלָּפְתוּ אָרְחוֹת דַּרְכָּם יַעֲלוּ בַתֹּהוּ וְיֹאבֵדוּ׃
verses.english: The caravans turn this way and that in their course: they go up into the waste, and perish.

verses.hebrew: הִבִּיטוּ אָרְחוֹת תֵּמָא הֲלִיכֹת שְׁבָא קִוּוּ־לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: The caravans of Tema looked, the companies of Sheva waited for them –

verses.hebrew: בֹּשׁוּ כִּי־בָטָח בָּאוּ עָדֶיהָ וַיֶּחְפָּרוּ׃
verses.english: they were confounded because they had hoped; they came there, and were abashed.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה הֱיִיתֶם לא [לוֹ] תִּרְאוּ חֲתַת וַתִּירָאוּ׃
verses.english: For now you are like it; you see terror, and are afraid.

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍כִי־אָמַרְתִּי הָבוּ לִי וּמִכֹּחֲכֶם שִׁחֲדוּ בַעֲדִי׃
verses.english: Did I say, Bring me something? or, Give a ransom for me out of your substance?

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְּטוּנִי מִיַּד־צָר וּמִיַּד עָרִיצִים תִּפְדּוּנִי׃
verses.english: or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of tyrants?

verses.hebrew: הוֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִי אַחֲרִישׁ וּמַה־שָּׁגִיתִי הָבִינוּ לִי׃
verses.english: Teach me, and I will hold my peace: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

verses.hebrew: מַה־נִּמְרְצוּ אִמְרֵי־יֹשֶׁר וּמַה־יּוֹכִיחַ הוֹכֵחַ מִכֶּם׃
verses.english: How forcible are right words! but what does your reproof seek to reprove?

verses.hebrew: הַלְהוֹכַח מִלִּים תַּחְשֹׁבוּ וּלְרוּחַ אִמְרֵי נֹאָשׁ׃
verses.english: Do you think your words to be a sound argument, but the sayings of a desperate man to be mere wind?

verses.hebrew: אַף־עַל־יָתוֹם תַּפִּילוּ וְתִכְרוּ עַל־רֵיעֲכֶם׃
verses.english: would you even overthrow an orphan, or seek to undermine your friend?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הוֹאִילוּ פְנוּ־בִי וְעַל־פְּנֵיכֶם אִם־אֲכַזֵּב׃
verses.english: Now therefore, be good enough to turn towards me: for surely I will not lie to your face.

verses.hebrew: שֻׁבוּ־נָא אַל־תְּהִי עַוְלָה ושבי [וְשׁוּבוּ] עוֹד צִדְקִי־בָהּ׃
verses.english: Return, I pray you, let there be no unfairness: and turn back again: my cause is just.

verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ־בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַוְלָה אִם־חִכִּי לֹא־יָבִין הַוּוֹת׃
verses.english: Is there injustice in my tongue? cannot my taste discern crafty devices?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־צָבָא לֶאֱנוֹשׁ על־[עֲלֵי־] אָרֶץ וְכִימֵי שָׂכִיר יָמָיו׃
verses.english: Has not a man hard service upon earth? and are not his days like the days of a hireling?

verses.hebrew: כְּעֶבֶד יִשְׁאַף־צֵל וּכְשָׂכִיר יְקַוֶּה פָעֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: As a servant earnestly desires the shadow, and as a hireling looks for the reward of his work:

verses.hebrew: כֵּן הָנְחַלְתִּי לִי יַרְחֵי־שָׁוְא וְלֵילוֹת עָמָל מִנּוּ־לִי׃
verses.english: so I am allotted months of emptiness, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי מָתַי אָקוּם וּמִדַּד־עָרֶב וְשָׂבַעְתִּי נְדֻדִים עֲדֵי־נָשֶׁף׃
verses.english: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro until the dawning of the day.

verses.hebrew: לָבַשׁ בְּשָׂרִי רִמָּה וגיש [וְגוּשׁ] עָפָר עוֹרִי רָגַע וַיִּמָּאֵס׃
verses.english: My flesh is clothed with worms; my skin is a clod of earth: it curdles and decays.

verses.hebrew: יָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי־אָרֶג וַיִּכְלוּ בְּאֶפֶס תִּקְוָה׃
verses.english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר כִּי־רוּחַ חַיָּי לֹא־תָשׁוּב עֵינִי לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃
verses.english: O remember that my life is a breath: my eye shall no more see good.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵנִי עֵין רֹאִי עֵינֶיךָ בִּי וְאֵינֶנִּי׃
verses.english: The eye of him who sees me shall see me no more: while Thy eyes are upon me, I am gone.

verses.hebrew: כָּלָה עָנָן וַיֵּלַךְ כֵּן יוֹרֵד שְׁאוֹל לֹא יַעֲלֶה׃
verses.english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away: so he who goes down to the grave shall come up no more.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָשׁוּב עוֹד לְבֵיתוֹ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: He shall return no more to his house, nor shall his place know him any more.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אֶחֱשָׂךְ פִּי אֲ‍דַבְּרָה בְּצַר רוּחִי אָשִׂיחָה בְּמַר נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍יָם־אָנִי אִם־תַּנִּין כִּי־תָשִׂים עָלַי מִשְׁמָר׃
verses.english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that Thou settest a watch over me?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי עַרְשִׂי יִשָּׂא בְשִׂיחִי מִשְׁכָּבִי׃
verses.english: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

verses.hebrew: וְחִתַּתַּנִי בַחֲלֹמוֹת וּמֵחֶזְיֹנוֹת תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃
verses.english: then Thou dost scare me with dreams, and dost terrify me through visions:

verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְחַר מַחֲנָק נַפְשִׁי מָוֶת מֵעַצְמוֹתָי׃
verses.english: so that my soul chooses strangling, and death rather than these my bones.

verses.hebrew: מָאַסְתִּי לֹא־לְעֹלָם אֶחְיֶה חֲדַל מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־הֶבֶל יָמָי׃
verses.english: I loathe it; I would not live always: let me alone; for my days are emptiness.

verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי תְגַדְּלֶנּוּ וְכִי־תָשִׁית אֵלָיו לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: What is man, that Thou shouldst magnify him? and that Thou shouldst set thy heart upon him?

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְקְדֶנּוּ לִבְקָרִים לִרְגָעִים תִּבְחָנֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: and that Thou shouldst remember him every morning, and try him every moment?

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה לֹא־תִשְׁעֶה מִמֶּנִּי לֹא־תַרְפֵּנִי עַד־בִּלְעִי רֻקִּי׃
verses.english: How long wilt Thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

verses.hebrew: חָטָאתִי מָה אֶפְעַל לָךְ נֹצֵר הָאָדָם לָמָה שַׂמְתַּנִי לְמִפְגָּע לָךְ וָאֶהְיֶה עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃
verses.english: If I have sinned, what do I do to Thee, O Thou preserver of men? why hast Thou set me as thy target, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.hebrew: וּמֶה לֹא־תִשָּׂא פִשְׁעִי וְתַעֲבִיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי כִּי־עַתָּה לֶעָפָר אֶשְׁכָּב וְשִׁחֲרְתַּנִי וְאֵינֶנִּי׃
verses.english: And why dost Thou not pardon my transgression, and take away my iniquity? for now I shall sleep in the dust; and Thou shalt seek me, but I shall not be.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי וַיֹאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Bildad the Shuĥite, and said,

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָן תְּמַלֶּל־אֵלֶּה וְרוּחַ כַּבִּיר אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃
verses.english: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

verses.hebrew: הַאֵל יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט וְאִם־שַׁדַּי יְעַוֵּת־צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: Does God pervert judgment? or does the Almighty pervert justice?

verses.hebrew: אִם־בָּנֶיךָ חָטְאוּ־לוֹ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם בְּיַד־פִּשְׁעָם׃
verses.english: If thy children have sinned against him, he has cast them out for their transgression.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אַתָּה תְּשַׁחֵר אֶל־אֵל וְאֶל־שַׁדַּי תִּתְחַנָּן׃
verses.english: If thou wilt seek to God, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

verses.hebrew: אִם־זַךְ וְיָשָׁר אָתָּה כִּי־עַתָּה יָעִיר עָלֶיךָ וְשִׁלַּם נְוַת צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: if thou be pure and upright; surely now he will rouse himself for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ מִצְעָר וְאַחֲרִיתְךָ יִשְׂגֶּה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy end will be very great.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁאַל־נָא לְדֹר רִישׁוֹן וְכוֹנֵן לְחֵקֶר אֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and attend assiduously to what their fathers have sought out:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְמוֹל אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא נֵדָע כִּי צֵל יָמֵינוּ עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: (for we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הֵם יוֹרוּךָ יֹאמְרוּ לָךְ וּמִלִּבָּם יוֹצִאוּ מִלִּים׃
verses.english: shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

verses.hebrew: הֲיִגְאֶה־גֹּמֶא בְּלֹא בִצָּה יִשְׂגֶּה־אָחוּ בְלִי־מָיִם׃
verses.english: Can the rush shoot up without mire? can the reed grass grow without water?

verses.hebrew: עֹדֶנּוּ בְאִבּוֹ לֹא יִקָּטֵף וְלִפְנֵי כָל־חָצִיר יִיבָשׁ׃
verses.english: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, and not cut down, it withers before any other herb.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל־שֹׁכְחֵי אֵל וְתִקְוַת חָנֵף תֹּאבֵד׃
verses.english: So are the paths of all who forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יָקוֹט כִּסְלוֹ וּבֵית עַכָּבִישׁ מִבְטַחוֹ׃
verses.english: whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׁעֵן עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד יַחֲזִיק בּוֹ וְלֹא יָקוּם׃
verses.english: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

verses.hebrew: רָטֹב הוּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁמֶשׁ וְעַל גַּנָּתוֹ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תֵצֵא׃
verses.english: He is green before the sun, and his branch shoots forth over his garden wall.

verses.hebrew: עַל־גַּל שָׁרָשָׁיו יְסֻבָּכוּ בֵּית אֲבָנִים יֶחֱזֶה׃
verses.english: His roots are wrapped about the stone heap: he selects for himself a place of stones.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְכִחֶשׁ בּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיךָ׃
verses.english: But if one destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־הוּא מְשׂוֹשׂ דַּרְכּוֹ וּמֵעָפָר אַחֵר יִצְמָחוּ׃
verses.english: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others spring.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל לֹא יִמְאַס־תָּם וְלֹא־יַחֲזִיק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִים׃
verses.english: Behold, God will not cast away an innocent man, nor will he uphold evildoers.

verses.hebrew: עַד־יְמַלֵּה שְׂחוֹק פִּיךָ וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ תְרוּעָה׃
verses.english: He will yet fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

verses.hebrew: שֹׂנְאֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וְאֹהֶל רְשָׁעִים אֵינֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: They who hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the tent of the wicked shall be no more.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: אָמְנָם יָדַעְתִּי כִי־כֵן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל׃
verses.english: Truly I know it is so: but how should a man be just before God?

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַחְפֹּץ לָרִיב עִמּוֹ לֹא־יַעֲנֶנּוּ אַחַת מִנִּי־אָלֶף׃
verses.english: If one will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

verses.hebrew: חֲכַם לֵבָב וְאַמִּיץ כֹּחַ מִי־הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם׃
verses.english: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and prospered?

verses.hebrew: הַמַּעְתִּיק הָרִים וְלֹא יָדָעוּ אֲשֶׁר הֲפָכָם בְּאַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: he who removes mountains, and they know not: when he overturns them in his anger:

verses.hebrew: הַמַּרְגִּיז אֶרֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וְעַמּוּדֶיהָ יִתְפַלָּצוּן׃
verses.english: who shakes the earth out of her place, and its pillars tremble:

verses.hebrew: הָאֹמֵר לַחֶרֶס וְלֹא יִזְרָח וּבְעַד כּוֹכָבִים יַחְתֹּם׃
verses.english: who commands the sun, and it rises not; and seals up the stars.

verses.hebrew: נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדּוֹ וְדוֹרֵךְ עַל־בָּמֳתֵי יָם׃
verses.english: He alone spreads out the heavens, and treads upon the waves of the sea:

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה־עָשׁ כְּסִיל וְכִימָה וְחַדְרֵי תֵמָן׃
verses.english: who makes the Bear, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south wind:

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד־אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
verses.english: who does great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעֲבֹר עָלַי וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה וְיַחֲלֹף וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ׃
verses.english: Lo, he goes by me, and I see him not: he passes on also, but I perceive him not.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יַחְתֹּף מִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ מִי־יֹאמַר אֵלָיו מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Behold, he snatches away, who can hinder him? who will say to him, What doest Thou?

verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ תחתו [תַּחְתָּיו] שָׁחֲחוּ עֹזְרֵי רָהַב׃
verses.english: God will not withdraw his anger: the helpers of Rahav stoop under him.

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ אֶבְחֲרָה דְבָרַי עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אִם־צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶעֱנֶה לִמְשֹׁפְטִי אֶתְחַנָּן׃
verses.english: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to him who contends with me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי לֹא־אַאֲמִין כִּי־יַאֲזִין קוֹלִי׃
verses.english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet would I not believe that he had hearkened to my voice.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָה יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְהִרְבָּה פְצָעַי חִנָּם׃
verses.english: For he crushes me with a tempest, and multiplies my wounds without cause:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁב רוּחִי כִּי יַשְׂבִּעַנִי מַמְּרֹרִים׃
verses.english: he will not let me take my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לְכֹחַ אַמִּיץ הִנֵּה וְאִם־לְמִשְׁפָּט מִי יוֹעִידֵנִי׃
verses.english: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶצְדָּק פִּי יַרְשִׁיעֵנִי תָּם־אָנִי וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי׃
verses.english: Though I were just, my own mouth would condemn me: though I were innocent, he would prove me perverse.

verses.hebrew: תָּם־אָנִי לֹא־אֵדַע נַפְשִׁי אֶמְאַס חַיָּי׃
verses.english: Though I were innocent, yet would I not know myself: I would despise my life.

verses.hebrew: אַחַת הִיא עַל־כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי תָּם וְרָשָׁע הוּא מְכַלֶּה׃
verses.english: Therefore I said, It is all one: he destroys the innocent and the wicked.

verses.hebrew: אִם־שׁוֹט יָמִית פִּתְאֹם לְמַסַּת נְקִיִּם יִלְעָג׃
verses.english: If the scourge slay suddenly, he would mock at the trial of the innocent.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ נִתְּנָה בְיַד־רָשָׁע פְּנֵי־שֹׁפְטֶיהָ יְכַסֶּה אִם־לֹא אֵפוֹא מִי־הוּא׃
verses.english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covers the faces of its judges; if not he, then who is it?

verses.hebrew: וְיָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי־רָץ בָּרְחוּ לֹא־רָאוּ טוֹבָה׃
verses.english: Now my days are swifter than a runner: they flee away, they see no good.

verses.hebrew: חָלְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיּוֹת אֵבֶה כְּנֶשֶׁר יָטוּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹכֶל׃
verses.english: They pass away like the swift ships: like the vulture that swoops on the prey.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָה שִׂיחִי אֶעֶזְבָה פָנַי וְאַבְלִיגָה׃
verses.english: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my sad countenance, and comfort myself:

verses.hebrew: יָגֹרְתִּי כָל־עַצְּבֹתָי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי׃
verses.english: I am afraid of all my pains, I know that Thou wilt not hold me innocent.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי אֶרְשָׁע לָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל אִיגָע׃
verses.english: I shall be condemned; why then do I labour in vain?

verses.hebrew: אִם־הִתְרָחַצְתִּי במו־[בְמֵי־] שָׁלֶג וַהֲזִכּוֹתִי בְּבֹר כַּפָּי׃
verses.english: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

verses.hebrew: אָז בַּשַּׁחַת תִּטְבְּלֵנִי וְתִעֲבוּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָי׃
verses.english: yet shalt Thou plunge me in the ditch, and my own clothes shall abhor me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא־אִישׁ כָּמֹנִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ נָבוֹא יַחְדָּו בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵינוּ מוֹכִיחַ יָשֵׁת יָדוֹ עַל־שְׁנֵינוּ׃
verses.english: There is no umpire between us, who might lay his hand upon us both.

verses.hebrew: יָסֵר מֵעָלַי שִׁבְטוֹ וְאֵמָתוֹ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃
verses.english: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

verses.hebrew: אַדַבְּרָה וְלֹא אִירָאֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־כֵן אָנֹכִי עִמָּדִי׃
verses.english: for then I would speak, and not fear him; for I am not so in myself.

verses.hebrew: נָקְטָה נַפְשִׁי בְּחַיָּי אֶעֶזְבָה עָלַי שִׂיחִי אֲדַבְּרָה בְּמַר נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free utterance to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.hebrew: אֹמַר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ אַל־תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי הוֹדִיעֵנִי עַל מַה־תְּרִיבֵנִי׃
verses.english: I will say to God, Do not condemn me; inform why Thou dost contend with me.

verses.hebrew: הֲטוֹב לְךָ כִּי־תַעֲשֹׁק כִּי־תִמְאַס יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ וְעַל־עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים הוֹפָעְתָּ׃
verses.english: Is it good to Thee that Thou shouldst oppress, that Thou shouldst despise the work of Thy hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.hebrew: הַעֵינֵי בָשָׂר לָךְ אִם־כִּרְאוֹת אֱנוֹשׁ תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Hast Thou eyes of flesh? or seest Thou as man sees?

verses.hebrew: הֲכִימֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יָמֶיךָ אִם־שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ כִּימֵי גָבֶר׃
verses.english: Are Thy days as the days of man? are Thy years as man’s days,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְבַקֵּשׁ לַעֲוֺנִי וּלְחַטָּאתִי תִדְרוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: that Thou inquirest after my iniquity, and searchest after my sin;

verses.hebrew: עַל־דַּעְתְּךָ כִּי־לֹא אֶרְשָׁע וְאֵין מִיָּדְךָ מַצִּיל׃
verses.english: although Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of Thy hand?

verses.hebrew: יָדֶיךָ עִצְּבוּנִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּנִי יַחַד סָבִיב וַתְּבַלְּעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet Thou dost destroy me.

verses.hebrew: זְכָר־נָא כִּי־כַחֹמֶר עֲשִׂיתָנִי וְאֶל־עָפָר תְּשִׁיבֵנִי׃
verses.english: Remember, I beseech Thee, that Thou hast made me like clay; and wilt Thou bring me back to dust?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא כֶחָלָב תַּתִּיכֵנִי וְכַגְּבִנָּה תַּקְפִּיאֵנִי׃
verses.english: Hast Thou not poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

verses.hebrew: עוֹר וּבָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁנִי וּבַעֲצָמוֹת וְגִידִים תְּסֹכְכֵנִי׃
verses.english: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.hebrew: חַיִּים וָחֶסֶד עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי וּפְקֻדָּתְךָ שָׁמְרָה רוּחִי׃
verses.english: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and Thy providence has preserved my spirit.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה צָפַנְתָּ בִלְבָבֶךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־זֹאת עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: Yet these things hast Thou hidden in thy heart: I know that this is with Thee.

verses.hebrew: אִם־חָטָאתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּנִי וּמֵעֲוֺנִי לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי׃
verses.english: If I sin, then Thou markest me, and Thou wilt not acquit me from my iniquity.

verses.hebrew: אִם־רָשַׁעְתִּי אַלְלַי לִי וְצָדַקְתִּי לֹא־אֶשָּׂא רֹאשִׁי שְׂבַע קָלוֹן וּרְאֵה עָנְיִי׃
verses.english: If I be wicked, woe is me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head; for I am filled with disgrace, and I see my affliction.

verses.hebrew: וְיִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁחַל תְּצוּדֵנִי וְתָשֹׁב תִּתְפַּלָּא־בִי׃
verses.english: If my head is lifted up proudly, Thou huntest me like a lion: and again Thou dost work wonders against me.

verses.hebrew: תְּחַדֵּשׁ עֵדֶיךָ נֶגְדִּי וְתֶרֶב כַּעַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִי חֲלִיפוֹת וְצָבָא עִמִּי׃
verses.english: Thou renewest Thy witnesses against me, and increasest Thy indignation upon me; Thou dost bring fresh armies against me.

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה מֵרֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָנִי אֶגְוַע וְעַיִן לֹא־תִרְאֵנִי׃
verses.english: Why then hast Thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh, that I had perished, and no eye had seen me!

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיִיתִי אֶהְיֶה מִבֶּטֶן לַקֶּבֶר אוּבָל׃
verses.english: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־מְעַט יָמַי יחדל [וַחֲדָל] ישית [וְשִׁית] מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה מְּעָט׃
verses.english: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְלֹא אָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: Before I go whence I shall not return, to the land of darkness and the shadow of death,

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ עֵיפָתָה כְּמוֹ אֹפֶל צַלְמָוֶת וְלֹא סְדָרִים וַתֹּפַע כְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל׃
verses.english: A land of gloom, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Żofar the Na῾amatite, and said,

verses.hebrew: הֲרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֵעָנֶה וְאִם־אִישׁ שְׂפָתַיִם יִצְדָּק׃
verses.english: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be accounted in the right?

verses.hebrew: בַּדֶּיךָ מְתִים יַחֲרִישׁו וַתִּלְעַג וְאֵין מַכְלִם׃
verses.english: Should thy babble make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר זַךְ לִקְחִי וּבַר הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in Thy eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם מִי־יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ דַּבֵּר וְיִפְתַּח שְׂפָתָיו עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee:

verses.hebrew: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת חָכְמָה כִּי־כִפְלַיִם לְתוּשִׁיָּה וְדַע כִּי־יַשֶּׁה לְךָ אֱלוֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶךָ׃
verses.english: and that he would tell thee the secrets of wisdom, for wisdom is manifold! Know therefore that God exacts of thee less than thy iniquity deserves.

verses.hebrew: הַחֵקֶר אֱלוֹהַ תִּמְצָא אִם עַד־תַּכְלִית שַׁדַּי תִּמְצָא׃
verses.english: Canst thou find out the deep things of God? canst thou find out the purpose of the Almighty?

verses.hebrew: גָּבְהֵי שָׁמַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָל עֲמֻקָּה מִשְּׁאוֹל מַה־תֵּדָע׃
verses.english: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than She᾽ol; what canst thou know?

verses.hebrew: אֲרֻכָּה מֵאֶרֶץ מִדָּהּ וּרְחָבָה מִנִּי־יָם׃
verses.english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַחֲלֹף וְיַסְגִּיר וְיַקְהִיל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: If he pass by, or shut up, or call to judgment, then who can hinder him?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וַיַּרְא־אָוֶן וְלֹא יִתְבּוֹנָן׃
verses.english: For he knows vain men; and when he sees iniquity, shall he then take no notice of it?

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ נָבוּב יִלָּבֵב וְעַיִר פֶּרֶא אָדָם יִוָּלֵד׃
verses.english: But the stupid man shall become wise, when a wild ass’s colt, shall be turned into man!

verses.hebrew: אִם־אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ לִבֶּךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ אֵלָיו כַּפֶּךָ׃
verses.english: If thou prepare thy heart, and stretch out thy hands towards him;

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָוֶן בְּיָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵהוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ עַוְלָה׃
verses.english: if iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tents.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָז תִּשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ מִמּוּם וְהָיִיתָ מֻצָק וְלֹא תִירָא׃
verses.english: Surely then thou shalt lift up thy face without blemish; and thou shalt be steadfast, and shalt not fear:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל תִּשְׁכָּח כְּמַיִם עָבְרוּ תִזְכֹּר׃
verses.english: because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

verses.hebrew: וּמִצָּהֳרַיִם יָקוּם חָלֶד תָּעֻפָה כַּבֹּקֶר תִּהְיֶה׃
verses.english: and thy eye shall be clearer than the noonday; its darkness shall be like the morning.

verses.hebrew: וּבָטַחְתָּ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְחָפַרְתָּ לָבֶטַח תִּשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt look about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

verses.hebrew: וְרָבַצְתָּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְחִלּוּ פָנֶיךָ רַבִּים׃
verses.english: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; for many shall entreat thy favour.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵינֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּכְלֶינָה וּמָנוֹס אָבַד מִנְהֶם וְתִקְוָתָם מַפַּח־נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall turn to despair.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: And Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם־עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: No doubt but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־לִי לֵבָב כְּמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת־מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; yea, who knows not such things as these?

verses.hebrew: שְׂחֹק לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶהְיֶה קֹרֵא לֶאֱלוֹהַּ וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ שְׂחוֹק צַדִּיק תָּמִים׃
verses.english: I am as one who is become a laughing stock to his friend; that called upon God and he answered him; the just, the innocent man is a laughing stock.

verses.hebrew: לַפִּיד בּוּז לְעַשְׁתּוּת שַׁאֲנָן נָכוֹן לְמוֹעֲדֵי רָגֶל׃
verses.english: Contempt is ready in the thought of him that is at ease, for those that are ruined, that slip with their feet.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהָלִים לְשֹׁדְדִים וּבַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל לַאֲשֶׁר הֵבִיא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּיָדוֹ׃
verses.english: The tents of robbers prosper, and they who provoke God are secure; they who bring their God in their hand.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁאַל־נָא בְהֵמוֹת וְתֹרֶךָּ וְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְיַגֶּד־לָךְ׃
verses.english: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the birds of the sky, and they shall tell thee:

verses.hebrew: אוֹ שִׂיחַ לָאָרֶץ וְתֹרֶךָּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לְךָ דְּגֵי הַיָּם׃
verses.english: or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare to thee.

verses.hebrew: מִי לֹא־יָדַע בְּכָל־אֵלֶּה כִּי יַד־יְהוָה עָשְׂתָה זֹּאת׃
verses.english: Who knows not among all these that the hand of the Lord has done this;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־חָי וְרוּחַ כָּל־בְּשַׂר־אִישׁ׃
verses.english: in whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ אֹכֶל יִטְעַם־לוֹ׃
verses.english: Does not the ear try words as the palate tastes food?

verses.hebrew: בִּישִׁישִׁים חָכְמָה וְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים תְּבוּנָה׃
verses.english: With aged men is wisdom; and length of days brings understanding.

verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ חָכְמָה וּגְבוּרָה לוֹ עֵצָה וּתְבוּנָה׃
verses.english: With him is wisdom and might, he has counsel and understanding.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יַהֲרוֹס וְלֹא יִבָּנֶה יִסְגֹּר עַל־אִישׁ וְלֹא יִפָּתֵחַ׃
verses.english: Behold, he breaks down, and it cannot be built again: he shuts up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעְצֹר בַּמַּיִם וְיִבָשׁוּ וִישַׁלְּחֵם וְיַהַפְכוּ אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up: then he sends them out, and they overwhelm the earth.

verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ עֹז וְתוּשִׁיָּה לוֹ שֹׁגֵג וּמַשְׁגֶּה׃
verses.english: With him is strength and sound wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.hebrew: מוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִים שׁוֹלָל וְשֹׁפְטִים יְהוֹלֵל׃
verses.english: He leads counsellors away bereft of counsel, and makes judges fools.

verses.hebrew: מוּסַר מְלָכִים פִּתֵּחַ וַיֶּאְסֹר אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: He looses the bond of kings, and binds their loins with a girdle.

verses.hebrew: מוֹלִיךְ כֹּהֲנִים שׁוֹלָל וְאֵתָנִים יְסַלֵּף׃
verses.english: He leads priests away bereft of dignity, and overthrows the mighty.

verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר שָׂפָה לְנֶאֱמָנִים וְטַעַם זְקֵנִים יִקָּח׃
verses.english: He removes the speech of the trusty, and takes away the understanding of the aged.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וּמְזִיחַ אֲפִיקִים רִפָּה׃
verses.english: He pours contempt upon princes, and weakens the belt of the mighty.

verses.hebrew: מְגַלֶּה עֲמֻקוֹת מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵא לָאוֹר צַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂגִּיא לַגּוֹיִם וַיְאַבְּדֵם שֹׁטֵחַ לַגּוֹיִם וַיַּנְחֵם׃
verses.english: He makes nations great and destroys them: he disperses nations, and guides them.

verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר לֵב רָאשֵׁי עַם־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃
verses.english: He takes away the heart of the chiefs of the people of the land, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.hebrew: יְמַשְׁשׁוּ־חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אוֹר וַיַּתְעֵם כַּשִּׁכּוֹר׃
verses.english: They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them stagger like a drunken man.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־כֹּל רָאֲתָה עֵינִי שָׁמְעָה אָזְנִי וַתָּבֶן לָהּ׃
verses.english: Lo, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.

verses.hebrew: כְּדַעְתְּכֶם יָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם׃
verses.english: What you know, I know also: I am not inferior to you.

verses.hebrew: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶל־שַׁדַּי אֲדַבֵּר וְהוֹכֵחַ אֶל־אֵל אֶחְפָּץ׃
verses.english: Yet, I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם אַתֶּם טֹפְלֵי־שָׁקֶר רֹפְאֵי אֱלִל כֻּלְּכֶם׃
verses.english: But you are forgers of lies, you are all physicians of no value.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן הַחֲרֵשׁ תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וּתְהִי לָכֶם לְחָכְמָה׃
verses.english: O that you would altogether keep silent! and it should be your wisdom.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא תוֹכַחְתִּי וְרִבוֹת שְׂפָתַי הַקְשִׁיבוּ׃
verses.english: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל תְּדַבְּרוּ עַוְלָה וְלוֹ תְּדַבְּרוּ רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: Will you speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

verses.hebrew: הֲפָנָיו תִּשָּׂאוּן אִם־לָאֵל תְּרִיבוּן׃
verses.english: Will you show him partiality? will you contend on behalf of God?

verses.hebrew: הֲטוֹב כִּי־יַחְקֹר אֶתְכֶם אִם־כְּהָתֵל בֶּאֱנוֹשׁ תְּהָתֵלּוּ בוֹ׃
verses.english: Will it be well for you if he should search you out? or as one man deceives another, will you deceive him?

verses.hebrew: הוֹכֵחַ יוֹכִיחַ אֶתְכֶם אִם־בַּסֵּתֶר פָּנִים תִּשָּׂאוּן׃
verses.english: He will surely reprove you, if you secretly show partiality.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא שְׂאֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵת אֶתְכֶם וּפַחְדּוֹ יִפֹּל עֲלֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Shall not his majesty make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

verses.hebrew: זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵפֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹמֶר גַּבֵּיכֶם׃
verses.english: Your remembrances are like ashes; your bodies are like bodies of clay.

verses.hebrew: הַחֲרִישׁוּ מִמֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָנִי וְיַעֲבֹר עָלַי מָה׃
verses.english: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

verses.hebrew: עַל־מָה אֶשָּׂא בְשָׂרִי בְשִׁנָּי וְנַפְשִׁי אָשִׂים בְּכַפִּי׃
verses.english: For what? I will take my flesh in my teeth, and take my life in my hand.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יִקְטְלֵנִי לא [לוֹ] אֲיַחֵל אַךְ־דְּרָכַי אֶל־פָּנָיו אוֹכִיחַ׃
verses.english: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain my own ways before him.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־הוּא־לִי לִישׁוּעָה כִּי־לֹא לְפָנָיו חָנֵף יָבוֹא׃
verses.english: This also shall be my salvation: for a hypocrite shall not come before him.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וְאַחֲוָתִי בְּאָזְנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Hear diligently my speech, and let my declaration be in your ears.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא עָרַכְתִּי מִשְׁפָּט יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֲנִי אֶצְדָּק׃
verses.english: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be vindicated.

verses.hebrew: מִי־הוּא יָרִיב עִמָּדִי כִּי־עַתָּה אַחֲרִישׁ וְאֶגְוָע׃
verses.english: Who is he that will contend with me? for then I would hold my tongue and die.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־שְׁתַּיִם אַל־תַּעַשׂ עִמָּדִי אָז מִפָּנֶיךָ לֹא אֶסָּתֵר׃
verses.english: Only do not two things to me: then will I not hide myself from Thee.

verses.hebrew: כַּפְּךָ מֵעָלַי הַרְחַק וְאֵמָתְךָ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃
verses.english: Withdraw Thy hand far from me: and let not Thy terror make me afraid.

verses.hebrew: וּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶה אוֹ־אֲדַבֵּר וַהֲשִׁיבֵנִי׃
verses.english: Then call Thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and Thou answer me.

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה לִי עֲוֺנוֹת וְחַטָּאוֹת פִּשְׁעִי וְחַטָּאתִי הֹדִיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: How many are my iniquities and sins? let me know my transgression and my sin.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר וְתַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לָךְ׃
verses.english: Why dost Thou hide Thy face, and hold me for Thy enemy?

verses.hebrew: הֶעָלֶה נִדָּף תַּעֲרוֹץ וְאֶת־קַשׁ יָבֵשׁ תִּרְדֹּף׃
verses.english: Wilt Thou chase a driven leaf? and wilt Thou pursue the dry stubble?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תִכְתֹּב עָלַי מְרֹרוֹת וְתוֹרִישֵׁנִי עֲוֺנוֹת נְעוּרָי׃
verses.english: For Thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

verses.hebrew: וְתָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלַי וְתִשְׁמוֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָי עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁי רַגְלַי תִּתְחַקֶּה׃
verses.english: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly at all my paths; Thou settest Thy print upon the heels of my feet.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּרָקָב יִבְלֶה כְּבֶגֶד אֲכָלוֹ עָשׁ׃
verses.english: And he is consumed like rottenness; like a garment eaten by moths.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם יְלוּד אִשָּׁה קְצַר יָמִים וּשְׂבַע־רֹגֶז׃
verses.english: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

verses.hebrew: כְּצִיץ יָצָא וַיִּמָּל וַיִּבְרַח כַּצֵּל וְלֹא יַעֲמוֹד׃
verses.english: He comes forth like a flower, and is cut down: he flees also like a shadow, and does not endure.

verses.hebrew: אַף־עַל־זֶה פָּקַחְתָּ עֵינֶךָ וְאֹתִי תָבִיא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: And dost Thou open Thy eyes upon such a one, and bringest me into judgment with Thee?

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן טָהוֹר מִטָּמֵא לֹא אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

verses.hebrew: אִם חֲרוּצִים יָמָיו מִסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁיו אִתָּךְ חקו [חֻקָּיו] עָשִׂיתָ וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר׃
verses.english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with Thee, Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

verses.hebrew: שְׁעֵה מֵעָלָיו וְיֶחְדָּל עַד־יִרְצֶה כְּשָׂכִיר יוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשׁ לָעֵץ תִּקְוָה אִם־יִכָּרֵת וְעוֹד יַחֲלִיף וְיֹנַקְתּוֹ לֹא תֶחְדָּל׃
verses.english: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that its tender branch will not cease.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַזְקִין בָּאָרֶץ שָׁרְשׁוֹ וּבֶעָפָר יָמוּת גִּזְעוֹ׃
verses.english: Though its root grow old in the earth, and its stock die in the ground;

verses.hebrew: מֵרֵיחַ מַיִם יַפְרִחַ וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ־נָטַע׃
verses.english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

verses.hebrew: וְגֶבֶר יָמוּת וַיֶּחֱלָשׁ וַיִּגְוַע אָדָם וְאַיּוֹ׃
verses.english: But man dies, and is laid low; yea, man perishes, and where is he?

verses.hebrew: אָזְלוּ־מַיִם מִנִּי־יָם וְנָהָר יֶחֱרַב וְיָבֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The waters fail from the sea, and the river is parched, and dries up:

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ שָׁכַב וְלֹא־יָקוּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי שָׁמַיִם לֹא יָקִיצוּ וְלֹא־יֵעֹרוּ מִשְּׁנָתָם׃
verses.english: but man lies down, and does not rise: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן בִּשְׁאוֹל תַּצְפִּנֵנִי תַּסְתִּירֵנִי עַד־שׁוּב אַפֶּךָ תָּשִׁית לִי חֹק וְתִזְכְּרֵנִי׃
verses.english: O that Thou wouldst hide me in She᾽ol, that Thou wouldst keep me secret, until Thy wrath is past, that Thou wouldst appoint me a set time, and remember me!

verses.hebrew: אִם־יָמוּת גֶּבֶר הֲיִחְיֶה כָּל־יְמֵי צְבָאִי אֲיַחֵל עַד־בּוֹא חֲלִיפָתִי׃
verses.english: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my service I should wait, until my reward should come.

verses.hebrew: תִּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶךָּ לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ תִכְסֹף׃
verses.english: Thou shouldst call, and I would answer Thee: Thou shouldst have a desire to the work of Thy hands.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה צְעָדַי תִּסְפּוֹר לֹא־תִשְׁמוֹר עַל־חַטָּאתִי׃
verses.english: For now Thou numberest my steps: dost Thou not watch for my sin?

verses.hebrew: חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי וַתִּטְפֹּל עַל־עֲוֺנִי׃
verses.english: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and Thou dost daub my iniquity with wax.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם הַר־נוֹפֵל יִבּוֹל וְצוּר יֶעְתַּק מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: And surely the mountain falling crumbles away, and the rock is removed out of its place.

verses.hebrew: אֲבָנִים שָׁחֲקוּ מַיִם תִּשְׁטֹף־סְפִיחֶיהָ עֲפַר־אָרֶץ וְתִקְוַת אֱנוֹשׁ הֶאֱבַדְתָּ׃
verses.english: The waters wear the stones: the torrents wash away the dust of the earth; so Thou destroyest the hope of man.

verses.hebrew: תִּתְקְפֵהוּ לָנֶצַח וַיַּהֲלֹךְ מְשַׁנֶּה פָנָיו וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passes: Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

verses.hebrew: יִכְבְּדוּ בָנָיו וְלֹא יֵדָע וְיִצְעֲרוּ וְלֹא־יָבִין לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: His sons come to honour, and he knows it not; and they are brought low, but he perceives them not.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּשָׂרוֹ עָלָיו יִכְאָב וְנַפְשׁוֹ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָל׃
verses.english: Only when his flesh is on him does he feel pain, and while his soul is within him does he mourn.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Elifaz the Temanite, and said,

verses.hebrew: הֶחָכָם יַעֲנֶה דַעַת־רוּחַ וִימַלֵּא קָדִים בִּטְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Should a wise man utter windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

verses.hebrew: הוֹכֵחַ בְּדָבָר לֹא יִסְכּוֹן וּמִלִּים לֹא־יוֹעִיל בָּם׃
verses.english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

verses.hebrew: אַף־אַתָּה תָּפֵר יִרְאָה וְתִגְרַע שִׂיחָה לִפְנֵי־אֵל׃
verses.english: Yea, thou castest off fear, and thou dost slight the prayer that is made before God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְאַלֵּף עֲוֺנְךָ פִיךָ וְתִבְחַר לְשׁוֹן עֲרוּמִים׃
verses.english: For thy mouth utters thy iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

verses.hebrew: יַרְשִׁיעֲךָ פִיךָ וְלֹא־אָנִי וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָךְ׃
verses.english: Thy own mouth condemns thee, and not I: yea, thy own lips testify against thee.

verses.hebrew: הֲרִאישׁוֹן אָדָם תִּוָּלֵד וְלִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתָּ׃
verses.english: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

verses.hebrew: הַבְסוֹד אֱלוֹהַ תִּשְׁמָע וְתִגְרַע אֵלֶיךָ חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: Dost thou listen in to the council of God, and keep wisdom to thyself?

verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּדַעְתָּ וְלֹא נֵדָע תָּבִין וְלֹא־עִמָּנוּ הוּא׃
verses.english: What knowst thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

verses.hebrew: גַּם־שָׂב גַּם־יָשִׁישׁ בָּנוּ כַּבִּיר מֵאָבִיךָ יָמִים׃
verses.english: With us are both the greyheaded and very aged men, much older than thy father.

verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט מִמְּךָ תַּנְחֻמוֹת אֵל וְדָבָר לָאַט עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: Are the consolations of God too small for thee? or the word which he spoke softly with thee?

verses.hebrew: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ לִבֶּךָ וּמַה־יִּרְזְמוּן עֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Why does thy heart carry thee away? and why do thy eyes wink?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תָשִׁיב אֶל־אֵל רוּחֶךָ וְהֹצֵאתָ מִפִּיךָ מִלִּין׃
verses.english: that thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־יִזְכֶּה וְכִי־יִצְדַּק יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: What is man, that he should be clean? and one born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.hebrew: הֵן בקדשו [בִּקְדֹשָׁיו] לֹא יַאֲמִין וְשָׁמַיִם לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones; and the heavens are not clean in his sight:

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־נִתְעָב וְנֶאֱלָח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶה כַמַּיִם עַוְלָה׃
verses.english: how much less one who is abominable and filthy? man, who drinks iniquity like water?

verses.hebrew: אֲחַוְךָ שְׁמַע־לִי וְזֶה־חָזִיתִי וַאֲסַפֵּרָה׃
verses.english: I will tell thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִים יַגִּידוּ וְלֹא כִחֲדוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hidden it:

verses.hebrew: לָהֶם לְבַדָּם נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־עָבַר זָר בְּתוֹכָם׃
verses.english: to whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי רָשָׁע הוּא מִתְחוֹלֵל וּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים נִצְפְּנוּ לֶעָרִיץ׃
verses.english: The wicked man travails with pain all his days, through the number of years stored up for the tyrant.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל־פְּחָדִים בְּאָזְנָיו בַּשָּׁלוֹם שׁוֹדֵד יְבוֹאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַאֲמִין שׁוּב מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וצפו [וְצָפוּי] הוּא אֱלֵי־חָרֶב׃
verses.english: He does not believe that he will return out of darkness, and he is waited for by the sword.

verses.hebrew: נֹדֵד הוּא לַלֶּחֶם אַיֵּה יָדַע כִּי־נָכוֹן בְּיָדוֹ יוֹם־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.hebrew: יְבַעֲתֻהוּ צַר וּמְצוּקָה תִּתְקְפֵהוּ כְּמֶלֶךְ עָתִיד לַכִּידוֹר׃
verses.english: Trouble and anguish make him afraid; they prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָטָה אֶל־אֵל יָדוֹ וְאֶל־שַׁדַּי יִתְגַּבָּר׃
verses.english: For he stretches out his hand against God, and behaves proudly against the Almighty.

verses.hebrew: יָרוּץ אֵלָיו בְּצַוָּאר בַּעֲבִי גַּבֵּי מָגִנָּיו׃
verses.english: He runs upon him with neck armour, with the thick bosses of his bucklers:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כִסָּה פָנָיו בְּחֶלְבּוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ פִּימָה עֲלֵי־כָסֶל׃
verses.english: because he has covered his face with his fat, and has put collops of fat on his flanks.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכּוֹן עָרִים נִכְחָדוֹת בָּתִּים לֹא־יֵשְׁבוּ לָמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַתְּדוּ לְגַלִּים׃
verses.english: And he dwells in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabits, which are ready to become heaps.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֶעְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָקוּם חֵילוֹ וְלֹא־יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְלָם׃
verses.english: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their produce bend to the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָסוּר מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּשׁ שַׁלְהָבֶת וְיָסוּר בְּרוּחַ פִּיו׃
verses.english: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יַאֲמֵן בשו [בַּשָּׁיו] נִתְעָה כִּי־שָׁוְא תִּהְיֶה תְמוּרָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself: for vanity shall be his recompense.

verses.hebrew: בְּלֹא־יוֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵא וְכִפָּתוֹ לֹא רַעֲנָנָה׃
verses.english: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

verses.hebrew: יַחְמֹס כַּגֶּפֶן בִּסְרוֹ וְיַשְׁלֵךְ כַּזַּיִת נִצָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: He shall shake off his unripe grape like the vine, and shall cast off his flower like the olive.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲדַת חָנֵף גַּלְמוּד וְאֵשׁ אָכְלָה אָהֳלֵי־שֹׁחַד׃
verses.english: For the company of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

verses.hebrew: הָרֹה עָמָל וְיָלֹד אָוֶן וּבִטְנָם תָּכִין מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepares deceit.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי כְאֵלֶּה רַבּוֹת מְנַחֲמֵי עָמָל כֻּלְּכֶם׃
verses.english: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are you all.

verses.hebrew: הֲקֵץ לְדִבְרֵי־רוּחַ אוֹ מַה־יַּמְרִיצְךָ כִּי תַעֲנֶה׃
verses.english: Shall windy words have an end? or what provokes thee that thou answerest?

verses.hebrew: גַּם אָנֹכִי כָּכֶם אֲדַבֵּרָה לוּ־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם תַּחַת נַפְשִׁי אַחְבִּירָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמִלִּים וְאָנִיעָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמוֹ רֹאשִׁי׃
verses.english: Would I also speak as you do? if your soul were in my soul’s stead, would I join words together against you, and shake my head at you?

verses.hebrew: אֲאַמִּצְכֶם בְּמוֹ־פִי וְנִיד שְׂפָתַי יַחְשֹׂךְ׃
verses.english: I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֲדַבְּרָה לֹא־יֵחָשֵׂךְ כְּאֵבִי וְאַחְדְּלָה מַה־מִנִּי יַהֲלֹךְ׃
verses.english: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־עַתָּה הֶלְאָנִי הֲשִׁמּוֹתָ כָּל־עֲדָתִי׃
verses.english: But now it has made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵד הָיָה וַיָּקָם בִּי כַחֲשִׁי בְּפָנַי יַעֲנֶה׃
verses.english: And Thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up against me bears witness to my face.

verses.hebrew: אַפּוֹ טָרַף וַיִּשְׂטְמֵנִי חָרַק עָלַי בְּשִׁנָּיו צָרִי יִלְטוֹשׁ עֵינָיו לִי׃
verses.english: He tears me in his wrath, and hates me: he gnashes at me with his teeth; my enemy sharpens his eyes upon me.

verses.hebrew: פָּעֲרוּ עָלַי בְּפִיהֶם בְּחֶרְפָּה הִכּוּ לְחָיָי יַחַד עָלַי יִתְמַלָּאוּן׃
verses.english: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek scornfully; they gather themselves together against me.

verses.hebrew: יַסְגִּירֵנִי אֵל אֶל עֲוִיל וְעַל־יְדֵי רְשָׁעִים יִרְטֵנִי׃
verses.english: God has delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלֵו הָיִיתִי וַיְפַרְפְּרֵנִי וְאָחַז בְּעָרְפִּי וַיְפַצְפְּצֵנִי וַיְקִימֵנִי לוֹ לְמַטָּרָה׃
verses.english: I was at ease, but he broke me asunder: he has also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his target.

verses.hebrew: יָסֹבּוּ עָלַי רַבָּיו יְפַלַּח כִּלְיוֹתַי וְלֹא יַחְמוֹל יִשְׁפֹּךְ לָאָרֶץ מְרֵרָתִי׃
verses.english: His archers compass me round about, he cleaves my reins asunder, and does not spare; he pours out my gall upon the ground.

verses.hebrew: יִפְרְצֵנִי פֶרֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי־פָרֶץ יָרֻץ עָלַי כְּגִבּוֹר׃
verses.english: He breaks me with breach upon breach, he runs upon me like a giant.

verses.hebrew: שַׂק תָּפַרְתִּי עֲלֵי גִלְדִּי וְעֹלַלְתִּי בֶעָפָר קַרְנִי׃
verses.english: I have sewn sackcloth upon my skin, and have laid my horn in the dust.

verses.hebrew: פָּנַי חמרמרה [חֳמַרְמְרוּ] מִנִּי־בֶכִי וְעַל עַפְעַפַּי צַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: My face is scalded with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

verses.hebrew: עַל לֹא־חָמָס בְּכַפָּי וּתְפִלָּתִי זַכָּה׃
verses.english: though no injustice is in my hands; and my prayer is pure.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ אַל־תְּכַסִּי דָמִי וְאַל־יְהִי מָקוֹם לְזַעֲקָתִי׃
verses.english: O earth, cover not my blood, and let my cry have no pause.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַתָּה הִנֵּה־בַשָּׁמַיִם עֵדִי וְשָׂהֲדִי בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃
verses.english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my testimony is on high.

verses.hebrew: מְלִיצַי רֵעָי אֶל־אֱלוֹהַ דָּלְפָה עֵינִי׃
verses.english: My friends scorn me: but my eye pours out tears to God.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹכַח לְגֶבֶר עִם־אֱלוֹהַּ וּבֶן־אָדָם לְרֵעֵהוּ׃
verses.english: O that a man might plead his cause with God, as the son of man with his fellow!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁנוֹת מִסְפָּר יֶאֱתָיוּ וְאֹרַח לֹא־אָשׁוּב אֶהֱלֹךְ׃
verses.english: For when a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

verses.hebrew: רוּחִי חֻבָּלָה יָמַי נִזְעָכוּ קְבָרִים לִי׃
verses.english: My spirit is broken, my days are extinct, the grave is ready for me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא הֲתֻלִים עִמָּדִי וּבְהַמְּרוֹתָם תָּלַן עֵינִי׃
verses.english: Are there not mockers with me? and does not my eye dwell on their provocation?

verses.hebrew: שִׂימָה־נָּא עָרְבֵנִי עִמָּךְ מִי הוּא לְיָדִי יִתָּקֵעַ׃
verses.english: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with thyself: who else is there that will strike hands with me?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִבָּם צָפַנְתָּ מִּשָּׂכֶל עַל־כֵּן לֹא תְרֹמֵם׃
verses.english: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

verses.hebrew: לְחֵלֶק יַגִּיד רֵעִים וְעֵינֵי בָנָיו תִּכְלֶנָה׃
verses.english: They are as one who invites friends to have a share, whilst the eyes of his children fail.

verses.hebrew: וְהִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁל עַמִּים וְתֹפֶת לְפָנִים אֶהְיֶה׃
verses.english: He has made me also a byword of the peoples; and I shall be a horror to every face.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּכַהּ מִכַּעַשׂ עֵינִי וִיצֻרַי כַּצֵּל כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: My eye also is dim by reason of vexation, and all my members are as a shadow.

verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁמּוּ יְשָׁרִים עַל־זֹאת וְנָקִי עַל־חָנֵף יִתְעֹרָר׃
verses.english: Upright men are astonished at this, and the innocent stirs up himself against the godless.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹאחֵז צַדִּיק דַּרְכּוֹ וּטֳהָר־יָדַיִם יֹסִיף אֹמֶץ׃
verses.english: Yet the righteous holds on his way, and he that has clean hands grows stronger and stronger.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם כֻּלָּם תָּשֻׁבוּ וּבֹאוּ נָא וְלֹא־אֶמְצָא בָכֶם חָכָם׃
verses.english: But as for you all, return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

verses.hebrew: יָמַי עָבְרוּ זִמֹּתַי נִתְּקוּ מוֹרָשֵׁי לְבָבִי׃
verses.english: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

verses.hebrew: לַיְלָה לְיוֹם יָשִׂימוּ אוֹר קָרוֹב מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: They change the night into day, saying, The light is near when the darkness is at hand.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֲקַוֶּה שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתִי בַּחֹשֶׁךְ רִפַּדְתִּי יְצוּעָי׃
verses.english: If I look to She᾽ol as my home: if I spread my couch in the darkness:

verses.hebrew: לַשַּׁחַת קָרָאתִי אָבִי אָתָּה אִמִּי וַאֲחֹתִי לָרִמָּה׃
verses.english: if I say to the pit, Thou art my father; to the worm. Thou art my mother and my sister;

verses.hebrew: וְאַיֵּה אֵפוֹ תִקְוָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי מִי יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃
verses.english: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

verses.hebrew: בַּדֵּי שְׁאֹל תֵּרַדְנָה אִם־יַחַד עַל־עָפָר נָחַת׃
verses.english: Will they go down with me to the bars of She᾽ol? shall we descend together to the dust?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשֻּׁחִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Bildad the Shuĥite, and said,

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תְּשִׂימוּן קִנְצֵי לְמִלִּין תָּבִינוּ וְאַחַר נְדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: How long will you make a perversion of words? consider, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָה נִטְמִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Why are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

verses.hebrew: טֹרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ בְּאַפּוֹ הַלְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָזַב אָרֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־צוּר מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: He tears himself in his anger. Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? or shall the rock be removed out of his place?

verses.hebrew: גַּם אוֹר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְלֹא־יִגַּהּ שְׁבִיב אִשּׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.hebrew: אוֹר חָשַׁךְ בְּאָהֳלוֹ וְנֵרוֹ עָלָיו יִדְעָךְ׃
verses.english: The light shall be dark in his tent, and his candle over him shall be put out.

verses.hebrew: יֵצְרוּ צַעֲדֵי אוֹנוֹ וְתַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ עֲצָתוֹ׃
verses.english: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֻׁלַּח בְּרֶשֶׁת בְּרַגְלָיו וְעַל־שְׂבָכָה יִתְהַלָּךְ׃
verses.english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walks on a pitfall.

verses.hebrew: יֹאחֵז בְּעָקֵב פָּח יַחֲזֵק עָלָיו צַמִּים׃
verses.english: The trap shall take him by the heel, and the snare shall prevail against him.

verses.hebrew: טָמוּן בָּאָרֶץ חַבְלוֹ וּמַלְכֻּדְתּוֹ עֲלֵי נָתִיב׃
verses.english: The noose is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.hebrew: סָבִיב בִּעֲתֻהוּ בַלָּהוֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻהוּ לְרַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels:

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־רָעֵב אֹנוֹ וְאֵיד נָכוֹן לְצַלְעוֹ׃
verses.english: his first born shall he plagued with hunger, and his wife beset with calamity.

verses.hebrew: יֹאכַל בַּדֵּי עוֹרוֹ יֹאכַל בַּדָּיו בְּכוֹר מָוֶת׃
verses.english: He will devour the limbs of his skin: the firstborn doomed to die will devour his own limbs.

verses.hebrew: יִנָּתֵק מֵאָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַחוֹ וְתַצְעִדֵהוּ לְמֶלֶךְ בַּלָּהוֹת׃
verses.english: He shall be cut off from the tent of his security; and shall he brought to the king of terrors.

verses.hebrew: תִּשְׁכּוֹן בְּאָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי־לוֹ יְזֹרֶה עַל־נָוֵהוּ גָפְרִית׃
verses.english: In his tent dwells that which is none of his: brimstone is scattered on his habitation.

verses.hebrew: מִתַּחַת שָׁרָשָׁיו יִבָשׁוּ וּמִמַּעַל יִמַּל קְצִירוֹ׃
verses.english: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch wither.
