verses.hebrew: זִכְרוֹ־אָבַד מִנִּי־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־שֵׁם לוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי־חוּץ׃
verses.english: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

verses.hebrew: יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ מֵאוֹר אֶל־חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִתֵּבֵל יְנִדֻּהוּ׃
verses.english: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.hebrew: לֹא נִין לוֹ וְלֹא־נֶכֶד בְּעַמּוֹ וְאֵין שָׂרִיד בִּמְגוּרָיו׃
verses.english: He shall have neither son nor offspring among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.hebrew: עַל־יוֹמוֹ נָשַׁמּוּ אַחֲרֹנִים וְקַדְמֹנִים אָחֲזוּ שָׂעַר׃
verses.english: They who come after him shall be astonished at his day, as they who went before were affrighted.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֵלֶּה מִשְׁכְּנוֹת עַוָּל וְזֶה מְקוֹם לֹא־יָדַע־אֵל׃
verses.english: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him who knows not God.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תּוֹגְיוּן נַפְשִׁי וּתְדַכְּאוּנַנִי בְמִלִּים׃
verses.english: How long will you vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

verses.hebrew: זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים תַּכְלִימוּנִי לֹא־תֵבֹשׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִי׃
verses.english: These ten times have you reproached me: you are not ashamed that you slight me.

verses.hebrew: וְאַף־אָמְנָם שָׁגִיתִי אִתִּי תָּלִין מְשׁוּגָתִי׃
verses.english: And be it indeed that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמְנָם עָלַי תַּגְדִּילוּ וְתוֹכִיחוּ עָלַי חֶרְפָּתִּי׃
verses.english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ־אֵפוֹ כִּי־אֱלוֹהַּ עִוְּתָנִי וּמְצוּדוֹ עָלַי הִקִּיף׃
verses.english: know now that God has overthrown me, and has compassed me with his net.

verses.hebrew: הֵן אֶצְעַק חָמָס וְלֹא אֵעָנֶה אֲשַׁוַּע וְאֵין מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: Behold, I cry out, Violence, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no justice.

verses.hebrew: אָרְחִי גָדַר וְלֹא אֶעֱבוֹר וְעַל נְתִיבוֹתַי חֹשֶׁךְ יָשִׂים׃
verses.english: He has fenced up my way so that I cannot pass, and he has set darkness in my paths.

verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹדִי מֵעָלַי הִפְשִׁיט וַיָּסַר עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשִׁי׃
verses.english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.hebrew: יִתְּצֵנִי סָבִיב וָאֵלַךְ וַיַּסַּע כָּעֵץ תִּקְוָתִי׃
verses.english: He has destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and my hope he has uprooted like a tree.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַר עָלַי אַפּוֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵנִי לוֹ כְצָרָיו׃
verses.english: He has also kindled his wrath against me, and he counts me to him as one of his enemies.

verses.hebrew: יַחַד יָבֹאוּ גְדוּדָיו וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי דַּרְכָּם וַיַּחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְאָהֳלִי׃
verses.english: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tent.

verses.hebrew: אַחַי מֵעָלַי הִרְחִיק וְיֹדְעַי אַךְ־זָרוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: He has put my brethren far from me, and my acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

verses.hebrew: חָדְלוּ קְרוֹבָי וּמְיֻדָּעַי שְׁכֵחוּנִי׃
verses.english: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.hebrew: גָּרֵי בֵיתִי וְאַמְהֹתַי לְזָר תַּחְשְׁבֻנִי נָכְרִי הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: They who dwell in my house, and my womenservants, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

verses.hebrew: לְעַבְדִּי קָרָאתִי וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה בְּמוֹ־פִי אֶתְחַנֶּן־לוֹ׃
verses.english: I call my servant, and he gives me no answer; though I entreat him with my mouth.

verses.hebrew: רוּחִי זָרָה לְאִשְׁתִּי וְחַנֹּתִי לִבְנֵי בִטְנִי׃
verses.english: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and my cries to my own children.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־עֲוִילִים מָאֲסוּ בִי אָקוּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־בִי׃
verses.english: Yea, young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.

verses.hebrew: תִּעֲבוּנִי כָּל־מְתֵי סוֹדִי וְזֶה־אָהַבְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־בִי׃
verses.english: All my trusted friends abhor me: and they whom I love are turned against me.

verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹרִי וּבִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי וָאֶתְמַלְּטָה בְּעוֹר שִׁנָּי׃
verses.english: My bone cleaves to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

verses.hebrew: חָנֻּנִי חָנֻּנִי אַתֶּם רֵעָי כִּי יַד־אֱלוֹהַּ נָגְעָה בִּי׃
verses.english: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תִּרְדְּפֻנִי כְמוֹ־אֵל וּמִבְּשָׂרִי לֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
verses.english: Why do you, like God, persecute me, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן אֵפוֹ וְיִכָּתְבוּן מִלָּי מִי־יִתֵּן בַּסֵּפֶר וְיֻחָקוּ׃
verses.english: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were inscribed in a book!

verses.hebrew: בְּעֵט־בַּרְזֶל וְעֹפָרֶת לָעַד בַּצּוּר יֵחָצְבוּן׃
verses.english: that with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock for ever!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי גֹּאֲלִי חָי וְאַחֲרוֹן עַל־עָפָר יָקוּם׃
verses.english: For I know that my avenger lives, and that he who outlives all things, will rise when I shall be dust.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר עוֹרִי נִקְּפוּ־זֹאת וּמִבְּשָׂרִי אֶחֱזֶה אֱלוֹהַּ׃
verses.english: But whilst I am still in my flesh, though it be after my skin is torn from my body, I would see God:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי אֶחֱזֶה־לִּי וְעֵינַי רָאוּ וְלֹא־זָר כָּלוּ כִלְיֹתַי בְּחֵקִי׃
verses.english: that I might see him for myself: that my eyes might behold, and not another: in longing for that my reins are consumed within me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדָּף־לוֹ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ דָּבָר נִמְצָא־בִי׃
verses.english: And if you should say, Do we indeed persecute him? and is not the root of the matter found in me?

verses.hebrew: גּוּרוּ לָכֶם מִפְּנֵי־חֶרֶב כִּי־חֵמָה עֲוֺנוֹת חָרֶב לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן שדין [שַׁדּוּן׃]
verses.english: be afraid of the sword: for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know that there is judgment.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Żofar the Na῾amatite, and said,

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שְׂעִפַּי יְשִׁיבוּנִי וּבַעֲבוּר חוּשִׁי בִי׃
verses.english: Therefore my thoughts answer me, even because of my agitation that is in me.

verses.hebrew: מוּסַר כְּלִמָּתִי אֶשְׁמָע וְרוּחַ מִבִּינָתִי יַעֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: I have heard the censure which insults me, and the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

verses.hebrew: הֲזֹאת יָדַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַד מִנִּי שִׂים אָדָם עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Knowst thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

verses.hebrew: כִּי רִנְנַת רְשָׁעִים מִקָּרוֹב וְשִׂמְחַת חָנֵף עֲדֵי־רָגַע׃
verses.english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַעֲלֶה לַשָּׁמַיִם שִׂיאוֹ וְרֹאשׁוֹ לָעָב יַגִּיעַ׃
verses.english: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach the clouds;

verses.hebrew: כְּגֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵד רֹאָיו יֹאמְרוּ אַיּוֹ׃
verses.english: yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they who have seen him shall say, Where is he?

verses.hebrew: כַּחֲלוֹם יָעוּף וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּהוּ וְיֻדַּד כְּחֶזְיוֹן לָיְלָה׃
verses.english: He shall fly away like a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.

verses.hebrew: עַיִן שְׁזָפַתּוּ וְלֹא תוֹסִיף וְלֹא־עוֹד תְּשׁוּרֶנּוּ מְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; nor shall his place any more behold him.

verses.hebrew: בָּנָיו יְרַצּוּ דַלִּים וְיָדָיו תָּשֵׁבְנָה אוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall give back that which he has robbed.

verses.hebrew: עַצְמוֹתָיו מָלְאוּ עלומו [עֲלוּמָיו] וְעִמּוֹ עַל־עָפָר תִּשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: His bones are full of his youth; yet shall it lie down with him in the dust.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תַּמְתִּיק בְּפִיו רָעָה יַכְחִידֶנָּה תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

verses.hebrew: יַחְמֹל עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶנָּה וְיִמְנָעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ חִכּוֹ׃
verses.english: though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

verses.hebrew: לַחְמוֹ בְּמֵעָיו נֶהְפָּךְ מְרוֹרַת פְּתָנִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: yet his food in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

verses.hebrew: חַיִל בָּלַע וַיְקִאֶנּוּ מִבִּטְנוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ אֵל׃
verses.english: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִים יִינָק תַּהַרְגֵהוּ לְשׁוֹן אֶפְעֶה׃
verses.english: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵרֶא בִפְלַגּוֹת נַהֲרֵי נַחֲלֵי דְּבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה׃
verses.english: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the streams of honey and curd.

verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב יָגָע וְלֹא יִבְלָע כְּחֵיל תְּמוּרָתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲלֹס׃
verses.english: That which he laboured for he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down: from the riches of his trading he will have no enjoyment.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רִצַּץ עָזַב דַּלִּים בַּיִת גָּזַל וְלֹא יִבֶנֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Because he has oppressed and has forsaken the poor; he has violently taken away a house which he did not build;

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יָדַע שָׁלֵו בְּבִטְנוֹ בַּחֲמוּדוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃
verses.english: because his greed knew no rest, he will not save anything over of that which he coveted.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־שָׂרִיד לְאָכְלוֹ עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָחִיל טוּבוֹ׃
verses.english: None of his food shall be left; therefore shall his goods not prosper.

verses.hebrew: בִּמְלֹאות שִׂפְקוֹ יֵצֶר לוֹ כָּל־יַד עָמֵל תְּבוֹאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: In the fullness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: all the force of misery shall come upon him.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי לְמַלֵּא בִטְנוֹ יְשַׁלַּח־בּוֹ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְיַמְטֵר עָלֵימוֹ בִּלְחוּמוֹ׃
verses.english: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him into his flesh.

verses.hebrew: יִבְרַח מִנֵּשֶׁק בַּרְזֶל תַּחְלְפֵהוּ קֶשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of brass shall strike him through.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַף וַיֵּצֵא מִגֵּוָה וּבָרָק מִמְּרֹרָתוֹ יַהֲלֹךְ עָלָיו אֵמִים׃
verses.english: It is drawn, and comes out of his body; yea, the glittering blade comes out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־חֹשֶׁךְ טָמוּן לִצְפּוּנָיו תְּאָכְלֵהוּ אֵשׁ לֹא־נֻפָּח יֵרַע שָׂרִיד בְּאָהֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: Utter darkness is laid up for his treasures: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tent.

verses.hebrew: יְגַלּוּ שָׁמַיִם עֲוֺנוֹ וְאֶרֶץ מִתְקוֹמָמָה לוֹ׃
verses.english: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

verses.hebrew: יִגֶל יְבוּל בֵּיתוֹ נִגָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

verses.hebrew: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִים וְנַחֲלַת אִמְרוֹ מֵאֵל׃
verses.english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed to him by God.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וּתְהִי־זֹאת תַּנְחוּמֹתֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

verses.hebrew: שָׂאוּנִי וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר וְאַחַר דַּבְּרִי תַלְעִיג׃
verses.english: Suffer me that I may speak; and after I have spoken, mock on.

verses.hebrew: הֶאָנֹכִי לְאָדָם שִׂיחִי וְאִם־מַדּוּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַר רוּחִי׃
verses.english: As for me, is my complaint to man? why should I not be impatient?

verses.hebrew: פְּנוּ־אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ וְשִׂימוּ יָד עַל־פֶּה׃
verses.english: Turn to me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־זָכַרְתִּי וְנִבְהָלְתִּי וְאָחַז בְּשָׂרִי פַּלָּצוּת׃
verses.english: Even when I remember, I am afraid, and trembling takes holds of my flesh.

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ רְשָׁעִים יִחְיוּ עָתְקוּ גַּם־גָּבְרוּ חָיִל׃
verses.english: Why do the wicked live, become old, yea, grow mighty in power?

verses.hebrew: זַרְעָם נָכוֹן לִפְנֵיהֶם עִמָּם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶם לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

verses.hebrew: בָּתֵּיהֶם שָׁלוֹם מִפָּחַד וְלֹא שֵׁבֶט אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Their houses are safe without fear, nor is the rod of God upon them.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹרוֹ עִבַּר וְלֹא יַגְעִל תְּפַלֵּט פָּרָתוֹ וְלֹא תְשַׁכֵּל׃
verses.english: Their bull genders, and does not fail; their cow calves, and does not cast her calf.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלְּחוּ כַצֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶם וְיַלְדֵיהֶם יְרַקֵּדוּן׃
verses.english: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂאוּ כְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר וְיִשְׂמְחוּ לְקוֹל עוּגָב׃
verses.english: They take the timbrel and lyre, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

verses.hebrew: יבלו [יְכַלּוּ] בַטּוֹב יְמֵיהֶם וּבְרֶגַע שְׁאוֹל יֵחָתּוּ׃
verses.english: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וְדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ לֹא חָפָצְנוּ׃
verses.english: Therefore they say to God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of Thy ways.

verses.hebrew: מַה־שַׁדַּי כִּי־נַעַבְדֶנּוּ וּמַה־נּוֹעִיל כִּי נִפְגַּע־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray to him?

verses.hebrew: הֵן לֹא בְיָדָם טוּבָם עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃
verses.english: Lo, is their good not in their hand? let the counsel of the wicked be far from me.

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה נֵר־רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְיָבֹא עָלֵימוֹ אֵידָם חֲבָלִים יְחַלֵּק בְּאַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: How often is the candle of the wicked put out? and when does their calamity come upon them? does he distribute sorrows to them in his anger?

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כְּתֶבֶן לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּכְמֹץ גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃
verses.english: are they as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carries away?

verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָיו אוֹנוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם אֵלָיו וְיֵדָע׃
verses.english: God lays up his iniquity for the children: let him rather reward him, that he may know it!

verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ עינו [עֵינָיו] כִּידוֹ וּמֵחֲמַת שַׁדַּי יִשְׁתֶּה׃
verses.english: Let his eyes see his own destruction, and let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty!

verses.hebrew: כִּי מַה־חֶפְצוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּמִסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁיו חֻצָּצוּ׃
verses.english: For what pleasure has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is already complete?

verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל יְלַמֶּד־דָּעַת וְהוּא רָמִים יִשְׁפּוֹט׃
verses.english: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judges those who are high.

verses.hebrew: זֶה יָמוּת בְּעֶצֶם תֻּמּוֹ כֻּלּוֹ שַׁלְאֲנַן וְשָׁלֵיו׃
verses.english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

verses.hebrew: עֲטִינָיו מָלְאוּ חָלָב וּמֹחַ עַצְמוֹתָיו יְשֻׁקֶּה׃
verses.english: His vessels are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה יָמוּת בְּנֶפֶשׁ מָרָה וְלֹא־אָכַל בַּטּוֹבָה׃
verses.english: And another dies in the bitterness of his soul, and has never eaten of good things.

verses.hebrew: יַחַד עַל־עָפָר יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְרִמָּה תְּכַסֶּה עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worm shall cover them.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יָדַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם וּמְזִמּוֹת עָלַי תַּחְמֹסוּ׃
verses.english: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which you wrongfully imagine against me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ אַיֵּה בֵית־נָדִיב וְאַיֵּה אֹהֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: For you say, Where is the house of the prince? and where is the tent in which the wicked dwelt?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא שְׁאֶלְתֶּם עוֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ וְאֹתֹתָם לֹא תְנַכֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: Have you not asked those who go by the way? and do not falsify their tokens;

verses.hebrew: כִּי לְיוֹם אֵיד יֵחָשֶׂךְ רָע לְיוֹם עֲבָרוֹת יוּבָלוּ׃
verses.english: that the wicked man is reserved for the day of destruction; that they shall be led forth to the day of wrath.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יַגִּיד עַל־פָּנָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וְהוּא־עָשָׂה מִי יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ׃
verses.english: But who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him for what he has done?

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא לִקְבָרוֹת יוּבָל וְעַל־גָּדִישׁ יִשְׁקוֹד׃
verses.english: For he is brought to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.

verses.hebrew: מָתְקוּ־לוֹ רִגְבֵי נָחַל וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָם יִמְשׁוֹךְ וּלְפָנָיו אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
verses.english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him, and every man shall draw after him, and there are innumerable going before him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמוּנִי הָבֶל וּתְשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם נִשְׁאַר־מָעַל׃
verses.english: Why then do you comfort me in vain, seeing in your answers there remains falsehood?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּמָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Elifaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר כִּי־יִסְכֹּן עָלֵימוֹ מַשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he that is wise is profitable to himself!

verses.hebrew: הַחֵפֶץ לְשַׁדַּי כִּי תִצְדָּק וְאִם־בֶּצַע כִּי־תַתֵּם דְּרָכֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

verses.hebrew: הֲמִיִּרְאָתְךָ יֹכִיחֶךָ יָבוֹא עִמְּךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא רָעָתְךָ רַבָּה וְאֵין־קֵץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Is not thy wickedness great? and thy iniquities infinite?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תַחְבֹּל אַחֶיךָ חִנָּם וּבִגְדֵי עֲרוּמִּים תַּפְשִׁיט׃
verses.english: For thou hast taken pledges from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־מַיִם עָיֵף תַּשְׁקֶה וּמֵרָעֵב תִּמְנַע־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Thou has not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withheld bread from the hungry.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ זְרוֹעַ לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים יֵשֶׁב בָּהּ׃
verses.english: But like the mighty man, who has the earth; and the honourable man who dwells in it,

verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּחְתָּ רֵיקָם וּזְרֹעוֹת יְתֹמִים יְדֻכָּא׃
verses.english: thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ פַחִים וִיבַהֶלְךָ פַּחַד פִּתְאֹם׃
verses.english: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubles thee;

verses.hebrew: אוֹ־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־תִרְאֶה וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לֹא־אֱלוֹהַּ גֹּבַהּ שָׁמָיִם וּרְאֵה רֹאשׁ כּוֹכָבִים כִּי־רָמּוּ׃
verses.english: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּדַע אֵל הַבְעַד עֲרָפֶל יִשְׁפּוֹט׃
verses.english: And thou sayst, What does God know? does he judge through the dark cloud?

verses.hebrew: עָבִים סֵתֶר־לוֹ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה וְחוּג שָׁמַיִם יִתְהַלָּךְ׃
verses.english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he sees not; and he walks in the circuit of heaven.

verses.hebrew: הַאֹרַח עוֹלָם תִּשְׁמֹר אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכוּ מְתֵי־אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־קֻמְּטוּ וְלֹא־עֵת נָהָר יוּצַק יְסוֹדָם׃
verses.english: who were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

verses.hebrew: הָאֹמְרִים לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַל שַׁדַּי לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: who said to God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא מִלֵּא בָתֵּיהֶם טוֹב וַעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃
verses.english: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְנָקִי יִלְעַג־לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn, saying,

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא נִכְחַד קִימָנוּ וְיִתְרָם אָכְלָה אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Surely our adversaries are cut off, and the remnant of them the fire consumes.

verses.hebrew: הַסְכֶּן־נָא עִמּוֹ וּשְׁלם בָּהֶם תְּבוֹאַתְךָ טוֹבָה׃
verses.english: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come to thee.

verses.hebrew: קַח־נָא מִפִּיו תּוֹרָה וְשִׂים אֲמָרָיו בִּלְבָבֶךָ׃
verses.english: Receive, I pray thee, Tora from his mouth, and lay up his words in thy heart.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תָּשׁוּב עַד־שַׁדַּי תִּבָּנֶה תַּרְחִיק עַוְלָה מֵאָהֳלֶךָ׃
verses.english: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tent.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָר בָּצֶר וּבְצוּר נְחָלִים אוֹפִיר׃
verses.english: And thou shalt hold gold as dust, and the gold of Ofir as the stones of the brooks.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה שַׁדַּי בְּצָרֶיךָ וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָךְ׃
verses.english: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy gold, and precious silver to thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָז עַל־שַׁדַּי תִּתְעַנָּג וְתִשָּׂא אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shall lift up thy face to God.

verses.hebrew: תַּעְתִּיר אֵלָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶךָּ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תְשַׁלֵּם׃
verses.english: Thou shalt make thy prayer to him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

verses.hebrew: וְתִגְזַר־אוֹמֶר וְיָקָם לָךְ וְעַל־דְּרָכֶיךָ נָגַהּ אוֹר׃
verses.english: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּאמֶר גֵּוָה וְשַׁח עֵינַיִם יוֹשִׁעַ׃
verses.english: When men have humbled thee, and thou sayst, There is lifting up, then he shall save the humble person.

verses.hebrew: יְמַלֵּט אִי־נָקִי וְנִמְלַט בְּבֹר כַּפֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: He delivers the innocent man: and thou shalt be delivered by the pureness of thy hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: גַּם־הַיּוֹם מְרִי שִׂחִי יָדִי כָּבְדָה עַל־אַנְחָתִי׃
verses.english: Even today my complaint is bitter: my stroke is heavy because of my groaning.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן יָדַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵהוּ אָבוֹא עַד־תְּכוּנָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

verses.hebrew: אֶעֶרְכָה לְפָנָיו מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי אֲמַלֵּא תוֹכָחוֹת׃
verses.english: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.hebrew: אֵדְעָה מִלִּים יַעֲנֵנִי וְאָבִינָה מַה־יֹּאמַר לִי׃
verses.english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say to me.

verses.hebrew: הַבְּרָב־כֹּחַ יָרִיב עִמָּדִי לֹא אַךְ־הוּא יָשִׂם בִּי׃
verses.english: Would he contend with me in his great power? No; but he would give heed to me.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם יָשָׁר נוֹכָח עִמּוֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָה לָנֶצַח מִשֹּׁפְטִי׃
verses.english: There the upright might reason with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

verses.hebrew: הֵן קֶדֶם אֶהֱלֹךְ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְאָחוֹר וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ׃
verses.english: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

verses.hebrew: שְׂמֹאול בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְלֹא־אָחַז יַעְטֹף יָמִין וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה׃
verses.english: on the left hand, where he works, but I cannot behold him: he hides himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדַע דֶּרֶךְ עִמָּדִי בְּחָנַנִי כַּזָּהָב אֵצֵא׃
verses.english: for he knows the way that I take: when he has tried me, I shall come forth like gold.

verses.hebrew: בַּאֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָה רַגְלִי דַּרְכּוֹ שָׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא־אָט׃
verses.english: My foot has held fast to his steps; his way have I kept, and not turned aside.

verses.hebrew: מִצְוַת שְׂפָתָיו וְלֹא אָמִישׁ מֵחֻקִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִיו׃
verses.english: Nor have I gone back from the commandment of his lips, I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּעַשׂ׃
verses.english: But he is unchangeable, and who can turn him? and what his soul desires, even that he does.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יַשְׁלִים חֻקִּי וְכָהֵנָּה רַבּוֹת עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: For he performs the thing that is appointed for me and many such things are with him.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן מִפָּנָיו אֶבָּהֵל אֶתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֶפְחַד מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: Therefore am I terrified at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵל הֵרַךְ לִבִּי וְשַׁדַּי הִבְהִילָנִי׃
verses.english: For God makes my heart faint, and the Almighty has affrighted me:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא נִצְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִפָּנַי כִּסָּה־אֹפֶל׃
verses.english: because I was not cut off before the darkness, nor did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ מִשַּׁדַּי לֹא־נִצְפְּנוּ עִתִּים וידעו [וְיֹדְעָיו] לֹא־חָזוּ יָמָיו׃
verses.english: Why are not times of judgment treasured up by the Almighty? and why do those who know him never see his days?

verses.hebrew: גְּבֻלוֹת יַשִּׂיגוּ עֵדֶר גָּזְלוּ וַיִּרְעוּ׃
verses.english: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed them.

verses.hebrew: חֲמוֹר יְתוֹמִים יִנְהָגוּ יַחְבְּלוּ שׁוֹר אַלְמָנָה׃
verses.english: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

verses.hebrew: יַטּוּ אֶבְיוֹנִים מִדָּרֶךְ יַחַד חֻבְּאוּ עֲנִיֵּי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together;

verses.hebrew: הֵן פְּרָאִים בַּמִּדְבָּר יָצְאוּ בְּפָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵי לַטָּרֶף עֲרָבָה לוֹ לֶחֶם לַנְּעָרִים׃
verses.english: behold, like wild asses in the desert, they go forth to their work; rising betimes to work for food: the wilderness yields food for them for their children;

verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׂדֶה בְּלִילוֹ יקצירו [יִקְצוֹרוּ] וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלַקֵּשׁוּ׃
verses.english: they reap his corn in the field; and they glean the vineyard of the wicked;

verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם יָלִינוּ מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת בַּקָּרָה׃
verses.english: they lie all night naked without clothing, and they have no covering in the cold;

verses.hebrew: מִזֶּרֶם הָרִים יִרְטָבוּ וּמִבְּלִי מַחְסֶה חִבְּקוּ־צוּר׃
verses.english: they are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

verses.hebrew: יִגְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁד יָתוֹם וְעַל־עָנִי יַחְבֹּלוּ׃
verses.english: These pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם הִלְּכוּ בְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וּרְעֵבִים נָשְׂאוּ עֹמֶר׃
verses.english: who go naked without clothing; and they that carry the sheaf are hungry;

verses.hebrew: בֵּין־שׁוּרֹתָם יַצְהִירוּ יְקָבִים דָּרְכוּ וַיִּצְמָאוּ׃
verses.english: they also make the oil within the olive rows of the wicked; they tread the winepresses, and suffer thirst.

verses.hebrew: מֵעִיר מְתִים יִנְאָקוּ וְנֶפֶשׁ־חֲלָלִים תְּשַׁוֵּעַ וֶאֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׂים תִּפְלָה׃
verses.english: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded cries out: yet God lays no blame on them.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה הָיוּ בְּמֹרְדֵי־אוֹר לֹא־הִכִּירוּ דְרָכָיו וְלֹא יָשְׁבוּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָיו׃
verses.english: They are of those who rebel against the light; they know not its ways, nor abide in its paths.

verses.hebrew: לָאוֹר יָקוּם רוֹצֵחַ יִקְטָל־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וּבַלַּיְלָה יְהִי כַגַּנָּב׃
verses.english: The murderer rising with the light kills the poor and needy, and in the night he is like a thief.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵין נֹאֵף שָׁמְרָה נֶשֶׁף לֵאמֹר לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵנִי עָיִן וְסֵתֶר פָּנִים יָשִׂים׃
verses.english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and he disguises his face.

verses.hebrew: חָתַר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ בָּתִּים יוֹמָם חִתְּמוּ־לָמוֹ לֹא־יָדְעוּ אוֹר׃
verses.english: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves up: they know not the light.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יַחְדָּו בֹּקֶר לָמוֹ צַלְמָוֶת כִּי־יַכִּיר בַּלְהוֹת צַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: For the morning is to them even as deep darkness: for he was acquainted with the terrors of deep darkness.

verses.hebrew: קַל־הוּא עַל־פְּנֵי־מַיִם תְּקֻלַּל חֶלְקָתָם בָּאָרֶץ לֹא־יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ כְּרָמִים׃
verses.english: He was swift upon the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: no treader turns towards their vineyards.

verses.hebrew: צִיָּה גַם־חֹם יִגְזְלוּ מֵימֵי־שֶׁלֶג שְׁאוֹל חָטָאוּ׃
verses.english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so does She᾽ol those who have sinned.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁכָּחֵהוּ רֶחֶם מְתָקוֹ רִמָּה עוֹד לֹא־יִזָּכֵר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר כָּעֵץ עַוְלָה׃
verses.english: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken like a tree.

verses.hebrew: רֹעֶה עֲקָרָה לֹא תֵלֵד וְאַלְמָנָה לֹא יְיֵטִיב׃
verses.english: He preys on the barren childless woman: and does not good to the widow.

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁךְ אַבִּירִים בְּכֹחוֹ יָקוּם וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין בַּחַיִּין׃
verses.english: And he draws the mighty away with his power: he rises up, and no man is sure of life.

verses.hebrew: יִתֶּן־לוֹ לָבֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵן וְעֵינֵיהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he rests; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

verses.hebrew: רוֹמּוּ מְּעַט וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְהֻמְּכוּ כַּכֹּל יִקָּפְצוּן וּכְרֹאשׁ שִׁבֹּלֶת יִמָּלוּ׃
verses.english: Go up a little, and he is no more: go down at all and they are shut up: they wither like the top of an ear of corn.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא אֵפוֹ מִי יַכְזִיבֵנִי וְיָשֵׂם לְאַל מִלָּתִי׃
verses.english: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשֻּׁחִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then answered Bildad the Shuĥite, and said,

verses.hebrew: הַמְשֵׁל וָפַחַד עִמּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו׃
verses.english: Dominion and fear are with him, he makes peace in his high places.

verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ מִסְפָּר לִגְדוּדָיו וְעַל־מִי לֹא־יָקוּם אוֹרֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Is there any number to his armies? and upon whom does not his light arise?

verses.hebrew: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל וּמַה־יִּזְכֶּה יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.hebrew: הֵן עַד־יָרֵחַ וְלֹא יַאֲהִיל וְכוֹכָבִים לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Behold even the moon has no brightness; and the stars are not pure in his sight.

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אֱנוֹשׁ רִמָּה וּבֶן־אָדָם תּוֹלֵעָה׃
verses.english: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, who is a maggot?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: And Iyyov answered and said,

verses.hebrew: מֶה־עָזַרְתָּ לְלֹא־כֹחַ הוֹשַׁעְתָּ זְרוֹעַ לֹא־עֹז׃
verses.english: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how hast thou saved the arm that has no strength?

verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּעַצְתָּ לְלֹא חָכְמָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה לָרֹב הוֹדָעְתָּ׃
verses.english: How hast thou counselled him that has no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared sound wisdom?

verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִי הִגַּדְתָּ מִלִּין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִי יָצְאָה מִמֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

verses.hebrew: הָרְפָאִים יְחוֹלָלוּ מִתַּחַת מַיִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The shades tremble; the waters beneath with the inhabitants thereof.

verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם שְׁאוֹל נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֲבַדּוֹן׃
verses.english: She᾽ol is naked before him, and Avaddon has no covering.

verses.hebrew: נֹטֶה צָפוֹן עַל־תֹּהוּ תֹּלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָה׃
verses.english: He stretches out the north over the empty place, and hangs the earth upon nothing.

verses.hebrew: צֹרֵר־מַיִם בְּעָבָיו וְלֹא־נִבְקַע עָנָן תַּחְתָּם׃
verses.english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.hebrew: מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי־כִסֵּה פַּרְשֵׁז עָלָיו עֲנָנוֹ׃
verses.english: He closes in the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud upon it.

verses.hebrew: חֹק־חָג עַל־פְּנֵי־מָיִם עַד־תַּכְלִית אוֹר עִם־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: He has compassed the waters with bounds, at the boundary between light and darkness.

verses.hebrew: עַמּוּדֵי שָׁמַיִם יְרוֹפָפוּ וְיִתְמְהוּ מִגַּעֲרָתוֹ׃
verses.english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

verses.hebrew: בְּכֹחוֹ רָגַע הַיָּם ובתובנתו [וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ] מָחַץ רָהַב׃
verses.english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smites through Rahav.

verses.hebrew: בְּרוּחוֹ שָׁמַיִם שִׁפְרָה חֹלֲלָה יָדוֹ נָחָשׁ בָּרִיחַ׃
verses.english: By his wind the heavens were made fair; his hand slew the slant serpent.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵלֶּה קְצוֹת דרכו [דְּרָכָיו] וּמַה־שֵּׁמֶץ דָּבָר נִשְׁמַע־בּוֹ וְרַעַם גבורתו [גְּבוּרוֹתָיו] מִי יִתְבּוֹנָן׃
verses.english: Lo, these are parts of his ways, and how terrifying is the thing that is heard of him; but the thunder of his power who can understand?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: And Iyyov continued his discourse, and said,

verses.hebrew: חַי־אֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵמַר נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: As God lives, who has taken away my right; and the Almighty, who has embittered my soul;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָל־עוֹד נִשְׁמָתִי בִי וְרוּחַ אֱלוֹהַּ בְּאַפִּי׃
verses.english: all the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

verses.hebrew: אִם־תְּדַבֵּרְנָה שְׂפָתַי עַוְלָה וּלְשׁוֹנִי אִם־יֶהְגֶּה רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: my lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

verses.hebrew: חָלִילָה לִּי אִם־אַצְדִּיק אֶתְכֶם עַד־אֶגְוָע לֹא־אָסִיר תֻּמָּתִי מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Far be it from me that I should justify you: till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

verses.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתִי הֶחֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹא אַרְפֶּהָ לֹא־יֶחֱרַף לְבָבִי מִיָּמָי׃
verses.english: My righteousness I hold fast, and I will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me as long as I live.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי כְרָשָׁע אֹיְבִי וּמִתְקוֹמְמִי כְעַוָּל׃
verses.english: Let my enemy be as the wicked, and he who rises up against me as the unrighteous.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מַה־תִּקְוַת חָנֵף כִּי יִבְצָע כִּי יֵשֶׁל אֱלוֹהַּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he has gained, when God takes away his soul?

verses.hebrew: הַצַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַע אֵל כִּי־תָבוֹא עָלָיו צָרָה׃
verses.english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes upon him?

verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּי יִתְעַנָּג יִקְרָא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵת׃
verses.english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

verses.hebrew: אוֹרֶה אֶתְכֶם בְּיַד־אֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שַׁדַּי לֹא אֲכַחֵד׃
verses.english: I will teach you concerning the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

verses.hebrew: הֵן־אַתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם חֲזִיתֶם וְלָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל תֶּהְבָּלוּ׃
verses.english: Behold, all you yourselves have seen it; why then do you thus altogether breathe emptiness?

verses.hebrew: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע עִם־אֵל וְנַחֲלַת עָרִיצִים מִשַּׁדַּי יִקָּחוּ׃
verses.english: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יִרְבּוּ בָנָיו לְמוֹ־חָרֶב וְצֶאֱצָאָיו לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

verses.hebrew: שרידו [שְׂרִידָיו] בַּמָּוֶת יִקָּבֵרוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃
verses.english: Those that remain of him shall be buried by some other death: and his widows shall not weep.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יִצְבֹּר כֶּעָפָר כָּסֶף וְכַחֹמֶר יָכִין מַלְבּוּשׁ׃
verses.english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

verses.hebrew: יָכִין וְצַדִּיק יִלְבָּשׁ וְכֶסֶף נָקִי יַחֲלֹק׃
verses.english: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

verses.hebrew: בָּנָה כָעָשׁ בֵּיתוֹ וּכְסֻכָּה עָשָׂה נֹצֵר׃
verses.english: He builds his house like the moth, and as a booth which the watchman makes.

verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר יִשְׁכַּב וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף עֵינָיו פָּקַח וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: A rich man shall he lie down, as though his wealth could not be summed up: he opens his eyes, and it is gone.

verses.hebrew: תַּשִּׂיגֵהוּ כַמַּיִם בַּלָּהוֹת לַיְלָה גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃
verses.english: Terrors overtake him like waters; a tempest steals him away in the night.

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂאֵהוּ קָדִים וְיֵלַךְ וִישָׂעֲרֵהוּ מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs: and it hurts him out of his place.

verses.hebrew: וְיַשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו וְלֹא יַחְמֹל מִיָּדוֹ בָּרוֹחַ יִבְרָח׃
verses.english: It hurls itself at him, and does not spare: he would fain flee out of its hand.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂפֹּק עָלֵימוֹ כַפֵּימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹק עָלָיו מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשׁ לַכֶּסֶף מוֹצָא וּמָקוֹם לַזָּהָב יָזֹקּוּ׃
verses.english: Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold where they refine it.

verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל מֵעָפָר יֻקָּח וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

verses.hebrew: קֵץ שָׂם לַחֹשֶׁךְ וּלְכָל־תַּכְלִית הוּא חוֹקֵר אֶבֶן אֹפֶל וְצַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: He puts an end to darkness, and searches out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

verses.hebrew: פָּרַץ נַחַל מֵעִם־גָּר הַנִּשְׁכָּחִים מִנִּי־רָגֶל דַּלּוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ נָעוּ׃
verses.english: He breaks open a watercourse in place far from inhabitants, forgotten by foot-travellers: they are dried up; they are gone away from men.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ מִמֶּנָּה יֵצֵא־לָחֶם וְתַחְתֶּיהָ נֶהְפַּךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

verses.hebrew: מְקוֹם־סַפִּיר אֲבָנֶיהָ וְעַפְרֹת זָהָב לוֹ׃
verses.english: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it has dust of gold.

verses.hebrew: נָתִיב לֹא־יְדָעוֹ עָיִט וְלֹא שְׁזָפַתּוּ עֵין אַיָּה׃
verses.english: There is a path which no bird of prey knows, and which the falcon’s eye has not seen:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִדְרִיכֻהוּ בְנֵי־שָׁחַץ לֹא־עָדָה עָלָיו שָׁחַל׃
verses.english: the lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

verses.hebrew: בַּחַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַח יָדוֹ הָפַךְ מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ הָרִים׃
verses.english: He puts forth his hand upon the rock; he overturns the mountains by the roots.

verses.hebrew: בַּצּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִים בִּקֵּעַ וְכָל־יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ׃
verses.english: He cuts out channels among the rocks; and his eye sees every precious thing.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּכִי נְהָרוֹת חִבֵּשׁ וְתַעֲלֻמָהּ יֹצִא אוֹר׃
verses.english: He binds the floods so that they do not trickle; and the thing that is hidden he brings forth to light.

verses.hebrew: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תִּמָּצֵא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃
verses.english: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָדַע אֱנוֹשׁ עֶרְכָּהּ וְלֹא תִמָּצֵא בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃
verses.english: Man cannot know its price; nor is it found in the land of the living.

verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם אָמַר לֹא בִי־הִיא וְיָם אָמַר אֵין עִמָּדִי׃
verses.english: The depth says, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֻתַּן סְגוֹר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְלֹא יִשָּׁקֵל כֶּסֶף מְחִירָהּ׃
verses.english: It cannot be gotten for gold, nor shall silver be weighed for its price.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְסֻלֶּה בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר בְּשֹׁהַם יָקָר וְסַפִּיר׃
verses.english: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ofir, with the precious shoham stone, or the sapphire.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה זָהָב וּזְכוֹכִית וּתְמוּרָתָהּ כְּלִי־פָז׃
verses.english: Gold and glass cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for vessels of fine gold.

verses.hebrew: רָאמוֹת וְגָבִישׁ לֹא יִזָּכֵר וּמֶשֶׁךְ חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים׃
verses.english: No mention shall be made of coral, or of crystal: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּוּשׁ בְּכֶתֶם טָהוֹר לֹא תְסֻלֶּה׃
verses.english: The chrysolite of Kush shall not equal it, nor shall it be valued with pure gold.

verses.hebrew: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃
verses.english: Whence then does wisdom come? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.hebrew: וְנֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵי כָל־חָי וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נִסְתָּרָה׃
verses.english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

verses.hebrew: אֲבַדּוֹן וָמָוֶת אָמְרוּ בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ שִׁמְעָהּ׃
verses.english: Avaddon and death say, We have heard a rumour of it with our ears.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים הֵבִין דַּרְכָּהּ וְהוּא יָדַע אֶת־מְקוֹמָהּ׃
verses.english: God understands its way, and he knows its place.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָרֶץ יַבִּיט תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְאֶה׃
verses.english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees everything under the whole heaven;

verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת לָרוּחַ מִשְׁקָל וּמַיִם תִּכֵּן בְּמִדָּה׃
verses.english: when he makes a weight for the winds; and he weighs the waters by measure.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ לַמָּטָר חֹק וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃
verses.english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

verses.hebrew: אָז רָאָהּ וַיְסַפְּרָהּ הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָהּ׃
verses.english: then he saw it, and declared it; he established it, yea, and searched it out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָאָדָם הֵן יִרְאַת אֲדֹנָי הִיא חָכְמָה וְסוּר מֵרָע בִּינָה׃
verses.english: And to man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Moreover Iyyov continued his discourse, and said,

verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתְּנֵנִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶדֶם כִּימֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵנִי׃
verses.english: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

verses.hebrew: בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ עֲלֵי רֹאשִׁי לְאוֹרוֹ אֵלֶךְ חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: when his candle shone upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי בִּימֵי חָרְפִּי בְּסוֹד אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵי אָהֳלִי׃
verses.english: as I was in the days of my youth, when God shielded my tent;

verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שַׁדַּי עִמָּדִי סְבִיבוֹתַי נְעָרָי׃
verses.english: when the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

verses.hebrew: בִּרְחֹץ הֲלִיכַי בְּחֵמָה וְצוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵי־שָׁמֶן׃
verses.english: when I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאתִי שַׁעַר עֲלֵי־קָרֶת בָּרְחוֹב אָכִין מוֹשָׁבִי׃
verses.english: when I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the broad place!

verses.hebrew: רָאוּנִי נְעָרִים וְנֶחְבָּאוּ וִישִׁישִׁים קָמוּ עָמָדוּ׃
verses.english: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

verses.hebrew: שָׂרִים עָצְרוּ בְמִלִּים וְכַף יָשִׂימוּ לְפִיהֶם׃
verses.english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל־נְגִידִים נֶחְבָּאוּ וּלְשׁוֹנָם לְחִכָּם דָּבֵקָה׃
verses.english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֹזֶן שָׁמְעָה וַתְּאַשְּׁרֵנִי וְעַיִן רָאֲתָה וַתְּעִידֵנִי׃
verses.english: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֲמַלֵּט עָנִי מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְיָתוֹם וְלֹא־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃
verses.english: because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, that had none to help him.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּת אֹבֵד עָלַי תָּבֹא וְלֵב אַלְמָנָה אַרְנִן׃
verses.english: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק לָבַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁנִי כִּמְעִיל וְצָנִיף מִשְׁפָּטִי׃
verses.english: I put on righteousness, and my justice clothed me, as a robe and a diadem.

verses.hebrew: עֵינַיִם הָיִיתִי לַעִוֵּר וְרַגְלַיִם לַפִּסֵּחַ אָנִי׃
verses.english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

verses.hebrew: אָב אָנֹכִי לָאֶבְיוֹנִים וְרִב לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵהוּ׃
verses.english: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּעוֹת עַוָּל וּמִשִּׁנָּיו אַשְׁלִיךְ טָרֶף׃
verses.english: And I broke the jaws of the wicked man, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עִם־קִנִּי אֶגְוָע וְכַחוֹל אַרְבֶּה יָמִים׃
verses.english: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days like the sand.

verses.hebrew: שָׁרְשִׁי פָתוּחַ אֱלֵי־מָיִם וְטַל יָלִין בִּקְצִירִי׃
verses.english: My root shall be spread out to the waters, and the dew shall lie all night upon my branch.

verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹדִי חָדָשׁ עִמָּדִי וְקַשְׁתִּי בְּיָדִי תַחֲלִיף׃
verses.english: My glory shall be fresh in me, and my bow shall be renewed in my hand.

verses.hebrew: לִי־שָׁמְעוּ וְיִחֵלּוּ וְיִדְּמוּ לְמוֹ עֲצָתִי׃
verses.english: To me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי דְבָרִי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ וְעָלֵימוֹ תִּטֹּף מִלָּתִי׃
verses.english: After my words they did not speak again; and my speech dropped upon them.

verses.hebrew: וְיִחֲלוּ כַמָּטָר לִי וּפִיהֶם פָּעֲרוּ לְמַלְקוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׂחַק אֲלֵהֶם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ וְאוֹר פָּנַי לֹא יַפִּילוּן׃
verses.english: If I laughed at them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

verses.hebrew: אֶבֲחַר דַּרְכָּם וְאֵשֵׁב רֹאשׁ וְאֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶלֶךְ בַּגְּדוּד כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲבֵלִים יְנַחֵם׃
verses.english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforts the mourners.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂחֲקוּ עָלַי צְעִירִים מִמֶּנִּי לְיָמִים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַסְתִּי אֲבוֹתָם לָשִׁית עִם־כַּלְבֵי צֹאנִי׃
verses.english: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־כֹּחַ יְדֵיהֶם לָמָּה לִּי עָלֵימוֹ אָבַד כָּלַח׃
verses.english: Indeed what could I gain from the strength of their hands, in whom the stock has perished?

verses.hebrew: בְּחֶסֶר וּבְכָפָן גַּלְמוּד הַעֹרְקִים צִיָּה אֶמֶשׁ שׁוֹאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה׃
verses.english: For want and famine they are solitary; they flee into the wilderness, into a gloomy waste and desolation.

verses.hebrew: הַקֹּטְפִים מַלּוּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂיחַ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ רְתָמִים לַחְמָם׃
verses.english: They cut up mallows by the bushes, and roots of broom for warmth.

verses.hebrew: מִן־גֵּו יְגֹרָשׁוּ יָרִיעוּ עָלֵימוֹ כַּגַּנָּב׃
verses.english: They are driven forth from among men, (they cry after them as after a thief;)

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲרוּץ נְחָלִים לִשְׁכֹּן חֹרֵי עָפָר וְכֵפִים׃
verses.english: to dwell in the clefts of the wadis, in holes of the earth, and in the rocks.

verses.hebrew: בֵּין־שִׂיחִים יִנְהָקוּ תַּחַת חָרוּל יְסֻפָּחוּ׃
verses.english: Among the bushes they bray; under the nettles they huddle together.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־נָבָל גַּם־בְּנֵי בְלִי־שֵׁם נִכְּאוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They are children of churls, yea, children of base men: they are whipped out of the land.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נְגִינָתָם הָיִיתִי וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמִלָּה׃
verses.english: And now I am their song, yea, I am their byword.

verses.hebrew: תִּעֲבוּנִי רָחֲקוּ מֶנִּי וּמִפָּנַי לֹא־חָשְׂכוּ רֹק׃
verses.english: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יתרו [יִתְרִי] פִתַּח וַיְעַנֵּנִי וְרֶסֶן מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּחוּ׃
verses.english: Because he has loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also cast off restraint before me.

verses.hebrew: עַל־יָמִין פִּרְחַח יָקוּמוּ רַגְלַי שִׁלֵּחוּ וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי אָרְחוֹת אֵידָם׃
verses.english: Upon my right hand rise the youthful rabble; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

verses.hebrew: נָתְסוּ נְתִיבָתִי לְהַוָּתִי יֹעִילוּ לֹא עֹזֵר לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: They mar my path, they further my calamity; they have no need for help.

verses.hebrew: כְּפֶרֶץ רָחָב יֶאֱתָיוּ תַּחַת שֹׁאָה הִתְגַּלְגָּלוּ׃
verses.english: They come upon me as through a wide breach: amid the crash they roll on.

verses.hebrew: הָהְפַּךְ עָלַי בַּלָּהוֹת תִּרְדֹּף כָּרוּחַ נְדִבָתִי וּכְעָב עָבְרָה יְשֻׁעָתִי׃
verses.english: Terrors are turned upon me: my dignity is pursued as by the wind: and my welfare passes away as a cloud.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה עָלַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשִׁי יֹאחֲזוּנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃
verses.english: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction have taken hold of me.

verses.hebrew: לַיְלָה עֲצָמַי נִקַּר מֵעָלָי וְעֹרְקַי לֹא יִשְׁכָּבוּן׃
verses.english: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

verses.hebrew: בְּרָב־כֹּחַ יִתְחַפֵּשׂ לְבוּשִׁי כְּפִי כֻתָּנְתִּי יַאַזְרֵנִי׃
verses.english: By the great force of my disease is my skin changed: it binds me about as the collar of my coat.

verses.hebrew: הֹרָנִי לַחֹמֶר וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל כֶּעָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃
verses.english: He has cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

verses.hebrew: אֲשַׁוַּע אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא תַעֲנֵנִי עָמַדְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּנֶן בִּי׃
verses.english: I cry to Thee, and Thou dost not answer me: I stand up, dost Thou then regard me?

verses.hebrew: תֵּהָפֵךְ לְאַכְזָר לִי בְּעֹצֶם יָדְךָ תִשְׂטְמֵנִי׃
verses.english: Thou art become cruel to me: with Thy strong hand Thou opposest Thyself against me.

verses.hebrew: תִּשָּׂאֵנִי אֶל־רוּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵנִי וּתְמֹגְגֵנִי תשוה [תּוּשִׁיָּה׃]
verses.english: Thou liftest me up to the wind; Thou causest me to ride upon it, and the roar of the storm dissolves me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדַעְתִּי מָוֶת תְּשִׁיבֵנִי וּבֵית מוֹעֵד לְכָל־חָי׃
verses.english: For I know that Thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־בְעִי יִשְׁלַח־יָד אִם־בְּפִידוֹ לָהֶן שׁוּעַ׃
verses.english: Yet does not one in a heap of ruins stretch out his hand? and in his disaster cry for help?

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא בָכִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־יוֹם עָגְמָה נַפְשִׁי לָאֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב קִוִּיתִי וַיָּבֹא רָע וַאֲיַחֲלָה לְאוֹר וַיָּבֹא אֹפֶל׃
verses.english: But when I looked for good, then evil came: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

verses.hebrew: מֵעַי רֻתְּחוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ קִדְּמֻנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃
verses.english: My bowels are in turmoil, and they do not rest: days of affliction have came upon me.

verses.hebrew: קֹדֵר הִלַּכְתִּי בְּלֹא חַמָּה קַמְתִּי בַקָּהָל אֲשַׁוֵּעַ׃
verses.english: I go mourning without the sun: I stand up, and I cry in the congregation.

verses.hebrew: אָח הָיִיתִי לְתַנִּים וְרֵעַ לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָה׃
verses.english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to owls.

verses.hebrew: עוֹרִי שָׁחַר מֵעָלָי וְעַצְמִי־חָרָה מִנִּי־חֹרֶב׃
verses.english: My skin hangs down black from me, and my bones are burned with heat.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְאֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִי וְעֻגָבִי לְקוֹל בֹּכִים׃
verses.english: Therefore my lyre is turned to mourning, and my pipe to the voice of those who weep.

verses.hebrew: בְּרִית כָּרַתִּי לְעֵינָי וּמָה אֶתְבּוֹנֵן עַל־בְּתוּלָה׃
verses.english: I have made a covenant with my eyes; why then should I look upon a virgin?

verses.hebrew: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִים׃
verses.english: For what would be my portion from God above, and my heritage from the Almighty on high?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֵיד לְעַוָּל וְנֵכֶר לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Is not destruction due to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הוּא יִרְאֶה דְרָכָי וְכָל־צְעָדַי יִסְפּוֹר׃
verses.english: Does he not see my ways, and count all my steps?

verses.hebrew: אִם־הָלַכְתִּי עִם־שָׁוְא וַתַּחַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָה רַגְלִי׃
verses.english: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁקְלֵנִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶדֶק וְיֵדַע אֱלוֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִי׃
verses.english: let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity.

verses.hebrew: אִם תִּטֶּה אַשֻּׁרִי מִנִּי הַדָּרֶךְ וְאַחַר עֵינַי הָלַךְ לִבִּי וּבְכַפַּי דָּבַק מֻאוּם׃
verses.english: If my step has turned out of the way, and my heart walked after my eyes, and if anything has cleaved to my hands;

verses.hebrew: אֶזְרְעָה וְאַחֵר יֹאכֵל וְצֶאֱצָאַי יְשֹׁרָשׁוּ׃
verses.english: then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

verses.hebrew: אִם־נִפְתָּה לִבִּי עַל־אִשָּׁה וְעַל־פֶּתַח רֵעִי אָרָבְתִּי׃
verses.english: If my heart has been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;

verses.hebrew: תִּטְחַן לְאַחֵר אִשְׁתִּי וְעָלֶיהָ יִכְרְעוּן אֲחֵרִין׃
verses.english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others bow down upon her.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוא [הִיא] זִמָּה והיא [וְהוּא] עָוֺן פְּלִילִים׃
verses.english: For that would be a heinous crime; yea, it would be iniquity to be punished by the judges.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵשׁ הִיא עַד־אֲבַדּוֹן תֹּאכֵל וּבְכָל־תְּבוּאָתִי תְשָׁרֵשׁ׃
verses.english: For it is a fire that consumes to Avaddon, and would root out all my increase.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶמְאַס מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדִּי וַאֲמָתִי בְּרִבָם עִמָּדִי׃
verses.english: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

verses.hebrew: וּמָה אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי־יָקוּם אֵל וְכִי־יִפְקֹד מָה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: what then shall I do when God rises up? and when he remembers, what shall I answer him?

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לֹא־בַבֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂנִי עָשָׂהוּ וַיְכֻנֶנּוּ בָּרֶחֶם אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Did not he who made me in the belly make him? and did not the same one fashion us in the womb?

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶמְנַע מֵחֵפֶץ דַּלִּים וְעֵינֵי אַלְמָנָה אֲכַלֶּה׃
verses.english: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

verses.hebrew: וְאֹכַל פִּתִּי לְבַדִּי וְלֹא־אָכַל יָתוֹם מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless have not eaten thereof;

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִנְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַנִי כְאָב וּמִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אַנְחֶנָּה׃
verses.english: (for from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹבֵד מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא בֵרֲכוּנִי חלצו [חֲלָצָיו] וּמִגֵּז כְּבָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּם׃
verses.english: if his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

verses.hebrew: אִם־הֲנִיפוֹתִי עַל־יָתוֹם יָדִי כִּי־אֶרְאֶה בַשַּׁעַר עֶזְרָתִי׃
verses.english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, even though I saw my help in the gate:

verses.hebrew: כְּתֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָה תִפּוֹל וְאֶזְרֹעִי מִקָּנָה תִשָּׁבֵר׃
verses.english: then let my arm fall from my shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

verses.hebrew: כִּי פַחַד אֵלַי אֵיד אֵל וּמִשְּׂאֵתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
verses.english: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his majesty I could do nothing.

verses.hebrew: אִם־שַׂמְתִּי זָהָב כִּסְלִי וְלַכֶּתֶם אָמַרְתִּי מִבְטַחִי׃
verses.english: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח כִּי־רַב חֵילִי וְכִי־כַבִּיר מָצְאָה יָדִי׃
verses.english: if I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹר כִּי יָהֵל וְיָרֵחַ יָקָר הֹלֵךְ׃
verses.english: if I beheld the sun when it shone, or the moon walking in brightness;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְתְּ בַּסֵּתֶר לִבִּי וַתִּשַּׁק יָדִי לְפִי׃
verses.english: and my heart had been secretly enticed, or my mouth had kissed my hand:

verses.hebrew: גַּם־הוּא עָוֺן פְּלִילִי כִּי־כִחַשְׁתִּי לָאֵל מִמָּעַל׃
verses.english: this also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges: for I should have betrayed the God that is above.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח בְּפִיד מְשַׂנְאִי וְהִתְעֹרַרְתִּי כִּי־מְצָאוֹ רָע׃
verses.english: Did I rejoice at the destruction of him who hates me, or did I exult when evil found him?

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָתַתִּי לַחֲטֹא חִכִּי לִשְׁאֹל בְּאָלָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Indeed I have not suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא אָמְרוּ מְתֵי אָהֳלִי מִי־יִתֵּן מִבְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא נִשְׂבָּע׃
verses.english: Have not the men of my tent said, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied?

verses.hebrew: בַּחוּץ לֹא־יָלִין גֵּר דְּלָתַי לָאֹרַח אֶפְתָּח׃
verses.english: But the stranger did not lodge in the street: I opened my doors to the traveller.

verses.hebrew: אִם־כִּסִּיתִי כְאָדָם פְּשָׁעָי לִטְמוֹן בְּחֻבִּי עֲוֺנִי׃
verses.english: Have I covered my transgressions like Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom?

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶעֱרוֹץ הָמוֹן רַבָּה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּחוֹת יְחִתֵּנִי וָאֶדֹּם לֹא־אֵצֵא פָתַח׃
verses.english: Did I fear the great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me? but I kept silence, and went not out of the door.

verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֶּן־לִי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי הֶן־תָּוִי שַׁדַּי יַעֲנֵנִי וְסֵפֶר כָּתַב אִישׁ רִיבִי׃
verses.english: Oh that one would hear me! here is my mark, let the Almighty answer me! and would that my adversary would pen his writ!

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא עַל־שִׁכְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶנּוּ אֶעֶנְדֶנּוּ עֲטָרוֹת לִי׃
verses.english: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

verses.hebrew: מִסְפַּר צְעָדַי אַגִּידֶנּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָגִיד אֲקָרֲבֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: I would declare to him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near to him.

verses.hebrew: אִם־עָלַי אַדְמָתִי תִזְעָק וְיַחַד תְּלָמֶיהָ יִבְכָּיוּן׃
verses.english: If my land cry against me, or its furrows complain together;

verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּחָהּ אָכַלְתִּי בְלִי־כָסֶף וְנֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלֶיהָ הִפָּחְתִּי׃
verses.english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to sigh:

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֹחַ וְתַחַת־שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה תַּמּוּ דִּבְרֵי אִיּוֹב׃
verses.english: let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Iyyov are ended.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה מֵעֲנוֹת אֶת־אִיּוֹב כִּי הוּא צַדִּיק בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: So these three men ceased to answer Iyyov, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת רָם בְּאִיּוֹב חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל־צַדְּקוֹ נַפְשׁוֹ מֵאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barakh᾽el the Buzite, of the family of Ram burned: against Iyyov his anger burned, because he justified himself rather than God.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁלֹשֶׁת רֵעָיו חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מָצְאוּ מַעֲנֶה וַיַּרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת־אִיּוֹב׃
verses.english: Also against his three friends did his anger burn, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Iyyov.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִיהוּ חִכָּה אֶת־אִיּוֹב בִּדְבָרִים כִּי זְקֵנִים־הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ לְיָמִים׃
verses.english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Iyyov because they were older than he.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלִיהוּא כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֶה בְּפִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his anger burned.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי וַיֹּאמַר צָעִיר אֲנִי לְיָמִים וְאַתֶּם יְשִׁישִׁים עַל־כֵּן זָחַלְתִּי וָאִירָא מֵחַוֺּת דֵּעִי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: And Elihu the son of Barakh᾽el the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and you are very old; therefore I was afraid, and durst not declare my opinion to you.

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי יָמִים יְדַבֵּרוּ וְרֹב שָׁנִים יֹדִיעוּ חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

verses.hebrew: אָכֵן רוּחַ־הִיא בֶאֱנוֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּבִינֵם׃
verses.english: But there is a spirit in man: and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־רַבִּים יֶחְכָּמוּ וּזְקֵנִים יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: The old are not always wise: nor do the aged understand judgment.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אָמַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּי אֲחַוֶּה דֵּעִי אַף־אָנִי׃
verses.english: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will express my opinion.

verses.hebrew: הֵן הוֹחַלְתִּי לְדִבְרֵיכֶם אָזִין עַד־תְּבוּנֹתֵיכֶם עַד־תַּחְקְרוּן מִלִּין׃
verses.english: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst you searched out what to say,

verses.hebrew: וְעָדֵיכֶם אֶתְבּוֹנָן וְהִנֵּה אֵין לְאִיּוֹב מוֹכִיחַ עוֹנֶה אֲמָרָיו מִכֶּם׃
verses.english: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Iyyov, or that answered his words.

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תֹּאמְרוּ מָצָאנוּ חָכְמָה אֵל יִדְּפֶנּוּ לֹא־אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Beware lest you say, We have found out wisdom: God will thrust him down, not man.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עָרַךְ אֵלַי מִלִּין וּבְאִמְרֵיכֶם לֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: Now he has not directed his words against me: so that I will not answer him with your speeches.

verses.hebrew: חַתּוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד הֶעְתִּיקוּ מֵהֶם מִלִּים׃
verses.english: They are amazed, they answer no more: they have left off speaking.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ כִּי עָמְדוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד׃
verses.english: And shall I wait because they do not speak; because they stand there, and answer no more?

verses.hebrew: אַעֲנֶה אַף־אֲנִי חֶלְקִי אֲחַוֶּה דֵעִי אַף־אָנִי׃
verses.english: I also will answer my part, I also will express my opinion.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מָלֵתִי מִלִּים הֱצִיקַתְנִי רוּחַ בִּטְנִי׃
verses.english: For I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains me.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־בִטְנִי כְּיַיִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵחַ כְּאֹבוֹת חֲדָשִׁים יִבָּקֵעַ׃
verses.english: Behold, my belly is like wine which has no vent; it is ready to burst like new wineskins.

verses.hebrew: אֲדַבְּרָה וְיִרְוַח־לִי אֶפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי וְאֶעֱנֶה׃
verses.english: I will speak, that I may find relief: I will open my lips and answer.

verses.hebrew: אַל־נָא אֶשָּׂא פְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאֶל־אָדָם לֹא אֲכַנֶּה׃
verses.english: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man’s person, nor let me give flattering titles to any man.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֲכַנֶּה כִּמְעַט יִשָּׂאֵנִי עֹשֵׂנִי׃
verses.english: For I do not know how to flatter; or else my maker would soon take me away.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁמַע־נָא אִיּוֹב מִלָּי וְכָל־דְּבָרַי הַאֲזִינָה׃
verses.english: But now, Iyyov, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא פָּתַחְתִּי פִי דִּבְּרָה לְשׁוֹנִי בְחִכִּי׃
verses.english: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth.

verses.hebrew: יֹשֶׁר־לִבִּי אֲמָרָי וְדַעַת שְׂפָתַי בָּרוּר מִלֵּלוּ׃
verses.english: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge in purity.

verses.hebrew: רוּחַ־אֵל עָשָׂתְנִי וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּחַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: The spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has given me life.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תּוּכַל הֲשִׁיבֵנִי עֶרְכָה לְפָנַי הִתְיַצָּבָה׃
verses.english: If thou canst, answer me; set thy words in order before me; stand up.

verses.hebrew: הֵן־אֲנִי כְפִיךָ לָאֵל מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי גַם־אָנִי׃
verses.english: Behold, I am towards God as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֵמָתִי לֹא תְבַעֲתֶךָּ וְאַכְפִּי עָלֶיךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּד׃
verses.english: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, nor shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אָמַרְתָּ בְאָזְנָי וְקוֹל מִלִּין אֶשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

verses.hebrew: זַךְ אֲנִי בְּלִי פָשַׁע חַף אָנֹכִי וְלֹא עָוֺן לִי׃
verses.english: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

verses.hebrew: הֵן תְּנוּאוֹת עָלַי יִמְצָא יַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לוֹ׃
verses.english: Behold, he finds occasions against me, he counts me for his enemy.

verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלָי יִשְׁמֹר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָי׃
verses.english: He puts my feet in the stocks, he marks all my paths.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־זֹאת לֹא־צָדַקְתָּ אֶעֱנֶךָּ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה אֱלוֹהַ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Behold, in this thou art not right: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ אֵלָיו רִיבוֹתָ כִּי כָל־דְּבָרָיו לֹא־יַעֲנֶה׃
verses.english: Why dost thou strive against him, seeing that none of his words will answer you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְאַחַת יְדַבֶּר־אֵל וּבִשְׁתַּיִם לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Surely God speaks once, yea twice, yet man perceives it not.

verses.hebrew: בַּחֲלוֹם חֶזְיוֹן לַיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים בִּתְנוּמוֹת עֲלֵי מִשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men, in slumberings upon the bed,

verses.hebrew: אָז יִגְלֶה אֹזֶן אֲנָשִׁים וּבְמֹסָרָם יַחְתֹּם׃
verses.english: then he opens the ears of men, and with discipline seals their instruction,

verses.hebrew: לְהָסִיר אָדָם מַעֲשֶׂה וְגֵוָה מִגֶּבֶר יְכַסֶּה׃
verses.english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

verses.hebrew: יַחְשֹׂךְ נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת וְחַיָּתוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁלַח׃
verses.english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּכַח בְּמַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וריב [וְרוֹב] עֲצָמָיו אֵתָן׃
verses.english: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

verses.hebrew: וְזִהֲמַתּוּ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם וְנַפְשׁוֹ מַאֲכַל תַּאֲוָה׃
verses.english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

verses.hebrew: יִכֶל בְּשָׂרוֹ מֵרֹאִי ושפי [וְשֻׁפּוּ] עַצְמוֹתָיו לֹא רֻאּוּ׃
verses.english: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרַב לַשַּׁחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְחַיָּתוֹ לַמְמִתִים׃
verses.english: For his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יֵשׁ עָלָיו מַלְאָךְ מֵלִיץ אֶחָד מִנִּי־אָלֶף לְהַגִּיד לְאָדָם יָשְׁרוֹ׃
verses.english: If there be an angel over him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to declare to man what is right:

verses.hebrew: וַיְחֻנֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר פְּדָעֵהוּ מֵרֶדֶת שָׁחַת מָצָאתִי כֹפֶר׃
verses.english: then he is gracious to him, and says, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

verses.hebrew: רֻטֲפַשׁ בְּשָׂרוֹ מִנֹּעַר יָשׁוּב לִימֵי עֲלוּמָיו׃
verses.english: His flesh shall be smoother than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

verses.hebrew: יֶעְתַּר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵהוּ וַיַּרְא פָּנָיו בִּתְרוּעָה וַיָּשֶׁב לֶאֱנוֹשׁ צִדְקָתוֹ׃
verses.english: he shall pray to God, and he will be favourable to him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render to man his righteousness.

verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁר עַל־אֲנָשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי וְיָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְלֹא־שָׁוָה לִי׃
verses.english: He should then assemble a row of men, and say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not.

verses.hebrew: פָּדָה נפשי [נַפְשׁוֹ] מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁחַת וחיתי [וְחַיָּתוֹ] בָּאוֹר תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Thus he will redeem his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־כָּל־אֵלֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵל פַּעֲמַיִם שָׁלוֹשׁ עִם־גָּבֶר׃
verses.english: Lo, God does all these things twice or three times with a man,

verses.hebrew: לְהָשִׁיב נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃
verses.english: to bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.hebrew: הַקְשֵׁב אִיּוֹב שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: Mark well, O Iyyov, hearken to me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּין הֲשִׁיבֵנִי דַּבֵּר כִּי־חָפַצְתִּי צַדְּקֶךָּ׃
verses.english: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: If not, hearken to me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Furthermore, Elihu answered and said,

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ חֲכָמִים מִלָּי וְיֹדְעִים הַאֲזִינוּ לִי׃
verses.english: Hear my words, O wise men; and give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ יִטְעַם לֶאֱכֹל׃
verses.english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה־טּוֹב׃
verses.english: Let us choose what is right: let us know among ourselves what is good.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי׃
verses.english: For Iyyov has said, I am righteous: and God has taken away my right:

verses.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי־פָשַׁע׃
verses.english: notwithstanding my right I am counted a liar; my wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.

verses.hebrew: מִי־גֶבֶר כְּאִיּוֹב יִשְׁתֶּה־לַּעַג כַּמָּיִם׃
verses.english: What man is like Iyyov, who drinks up scorning like water?

verses.hebrew: וְאָרַח לְחֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וְלָלֶכֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶשַׁע׃
verses.english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַר לֹא יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר בִּרְצֹתוֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: For he has said, It profits a man nothing that he should be in accord with God.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אַנֲשֵׁי לֵבָב שִׁמְעוּ לִי חָלִלָה לָאֵל מֵרֶשַׁע וְשַׁדַּי מֵעָוֶל׃
verses.english: Therefore hearken to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

verses.hebrew: כִּי פֹעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ וּכְאֹרַח אִישׁ יַמְצִאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: For the work of a man shall he pay back to him, and according to his ways will he cause to befall every man.

verses.hebrew: אַף־אָמְנָם אֵל לֹא־יַרְשִׁיעַ וְשַׁדַּי לֹא־יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, nor will the Almighty pervert justice.

verses.hebrew: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו אָרְצָה וּמִי שָׂם תֵּבֵל כֻּלָּהּ׃
verses.english: Who has given him a charge over the earth? or who has disposed the whole world?

verses.hebrew: אִם־יָשִׂים אֵלָיו לִבּוֹ רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ אֵלָיו יֶאֱסֹף׃
verses.english: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather to himself his spirit and his breath;

verses.hebrew: יִגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָחַד וְאָדָם עַל־עָפָר יָשׁוּב׃
verses.english: all flesh shall perish together, and man shall return to dust.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בִּינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּאת הַאֲזִינָה לְקוֹל מִלָּי׃
verses.english: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

verses.hebrew: הַאַף שׂוֹנֵא מִשְׁפָּט יַחֲבוֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר תַּרְשִׁיעַ׃
verses.english: Shall even one that hates right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

verses.hebrew: הַאֲמֹר לְמֶלֶךְ בְּלִיָּעַל רָשָׁע אֶל־נְדִיבִים׃
verses.english: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art base? and to princes, You are wicked?

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא פְּנֵי שָׂרִים וְלֹא נִכַּר־שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָל כִּי־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: How much less to him who does not respect the persons of princes, nor regards the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

verses.hebrew: רֶגַע יָמֻתוּ וַחֲצוֹת לָיְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁוּ עָם וְיַעֲבֹרוּ וְיָסִירוּ אַבִּיר לֹא בְיָד׃
verses.english: In a moment they die, at midnight the people are shaken, and pass away; for they are removed and spirited away without hands.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֵינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־צְעָדָיו יִרְאֶה׃
verses.english: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he sees all his goings.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־חֹשֶׁךְ וְאֵין צַלְמָוֶת לְהִסָּתֶר שָׁם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: There is no darkness, nor deep gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא עַל־אִישׁ יָשִׂים עוֹד לַהֲלֹךְ אֶל־אֵל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: For he will not lay upon man anything more, that he should enter into judgment with God.

verses.hebrew: יָרֹעַ כַּבִּירִים לֹא־חֵקֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד אֲחֵרִים תַּחְתָּם׃
verses.english: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יַכִּיר מַעְבָּדֵיהֶם וְהָפַךְ לַיְלָה וְיִדַּכָּאוּ׃
verses.english: Surely he knows their works, and he overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־רְשָׁעִים סְפָקָם בִּמְקוֹם רֹאִים׃
verses.english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר עַל־כֵּן סָרוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו וְכָל־דְּרָכָיו לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃
verses.english: because they turned back from following him, and would not have regard to any of his ways:

verses.hebrew: לְהָבִיא עָלָיו צַעֲקַת־דָּל וְצַעֲקַת עֲנִיִּים יִשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: so that they cause the cry of the poor to come to him, and he hears the cry of the afflicted.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יַשְׁקִט וּמִי יַרְשִׁעַ וְיַסְתֵּר פָּנִים וּמִי יְשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְעַל־גּוֹי וְעַל־אָדָם יָחַד׃
verses.english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? and when he hides his face, who then can behold him? Whether against a nation, or against a man alike:

verses.hebrew: מִמְּלֹךְ אָדָם חָנֵף מִמֹּקְשֵׁי עָם׃
verses.english: that the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶל־אֵל הֶאָמַר נָשָׂאתִי לֹא אֶחְבֹּל׃
verses.english: For surely it is fitting to say to God, I suffer, I will no more offend:

verses.hebrew: בִּלְעֲדֵי אֶחֱזֶה אַתָּה הֹרֵנִי אִם־עָוֶל פָּעַלְתִּי לֹא אֹסִיף׃
verses.english: that which I do not see teach me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

verses.hebrew: הַמֵעִמְּךָ יְשַׁלְמֶנָּה כִּי־מָאַסְתָּ כִּי־אַתָּה תִבְחַר וְלֹא־אָנִי וּמַה־יָדַעְתָּ דַבֵּר׃
verses.english: Shall he recompense it according to thy mind, when thou refusest his judgment? shall he say, Thou shalt choose, and not I; and speak what thou knowst.

verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי לֵבָב יֹאמְרוּ לִי וְגֶבֶר חָכָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי׃
verses.english: Men of understanding will tell me, and the wise man who hears me will say,

verses.hebrew: אִיּוֹב לֹא־בְדַעַת יְדַבֵּר וּדְבָרָיו לֹא בְהַשְׂכֵּיל׃
verses.english: Iyyov has spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

verses.hebrew: אָבִי יִבָּחֵן אִיּוֹב עַד־נֶצַח עַל־תְּשֻׁבֹת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Would that Iyyov may be tried to the end because he answers like wicked men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֹסִיף עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ פֶשַׁע בֵּינֵינוּ יִסְפּוֹק וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו לָאֵל׃
verses.english: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he strikes his fist among us, and multiplies his words against God.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּ וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Elihu spoke, and said,

verses.hebrew: הֲזֹאת חָשַׁבְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּט אָמַרְתָּ צִדְקִי מֵאֵל׃
verses.english: Thinkst thou this to be right, that thou dost say, My righteousness is more than God’s?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֹאמַר מַה־יִּסְכָּן־לָךְ מָה־אֹעִיל מֵחַטָּאתִי׃
verses.english: For thou dost say, What advantage will it be to thee? and, What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֲשִׁיבְךָ מִלִּין וְאֶת־רֵעֶיךָ עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

verses.hebrew: הַבֵּט שָׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וְשׁוּר שְׁחָקִים גָּבְהוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: Look to the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

verses.hebrew: אִם־חָטָאתָ מַה־תִּפְעָל־בּוֹ וְרַבּוּ פְשָׁעֶיךָ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃
verses.english: If thou hast sinned, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions are multiplied, what doest thou for him?

verses.hebrew: אִם־צָדַקְתָּ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לוֹ אוֹ מַה־מִיָּדְךָ יִקָּח׃
verses.english: If thou art righteous, what givest thou him? or what does he receive of thy hand?

verses.hebrew: לְאִישׁ־כָּמוֹךָ רִשְׁעֶךָ וּלְבֶן־אָדָם צִדְקָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

verses.hebrew: מֵרֹב עֲשׁוּקִים יַזְעִיקוּ יְשַׁוְּעוּ מִזְּרוֹעַ רַבִּים׃
verses.english: By reason of the multitude of oppressors the oppressed cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָמַר אַיֵּה אֱלוֹהַּ עֹשָׂי נֹתֵן זְמִרוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: But none says, Where is God my maker, who gives songs in the night;

verses.hebrew: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵנוּ׃
verses.english: who teaches us by the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser by the birds of the sky?

verses.hebrew: שָׁם יִצְעֲקוּ וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה מִפְּנֵי גְּאוֹן רָעִים׃
verses.english: There, when they cry he does not answer, because of the pride of evil men.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־שָׁוְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְשַׁדַּי לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, nor will the Almighty regard it.

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־תֹאמַר לֹא תְשׁוּרֶנּוּ דִּין לְפָנָיו וּתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ׃
verses.english: Although thou sayst, Thou wilt not regard it, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust in him.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּי־אַיִן פָּקַד אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָדַע בַּפַּשׁ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: But now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not heed the multitude of the words,

verses.hebrew: וְאִיּוֹב הֶבֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּיהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר׃
verses.english: therefore does Iyyov open his mouth in vain, and multiplies words without knowledge.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.hebrew: כַּתַּר־לִי זְעֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּךָּ כִּי עוֹד לֶאֱלוֹהַּ מִלִּים׃
verses.english: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; for I have yet words to speak on God’s behalf.

verses.hebrew: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק וּלְפֹעֲלִי אֶתֵּן־צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמְנָם לֹא־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּי תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: For truly my words are not false: one that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל כַּבִּיר וְלֹא יִמְאָס כַּבִּיר כֹּחַ לֵב׃
verses.english: Behold, God is mighty, and despises not any: he is mighty in strength of wisdom.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יְחַיֶּה רָשָׁע וּמִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיִּים יִתֵּן׃
verses.english: He preserves not the life of the wicked: but gives to the poor their right.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינָיו וְאֶת־מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא וַיֹּשִׁיבֵם לָנֶצַח וַיִּגְבָּהוּ׃
