verses.english: He withdraws not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings on the throne he establishes them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִים בַּזִּקִּים יִלָּכְדוּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹנִי׃
verses.english: And if they are bound in fetters, and are held in cords of affliction;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד לָהֶם פָּעֳלָם וּפִשְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי יִתְגַּבָּרוּ׃
verses.english: then he declares to them their work, and their transgressions when they behave arrogantly.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָוֶן׃
verses.english: He opens also their ear to discipline, and commands that they return from iniquity.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיַעֲבֹדוּ יְכַלּוּ יְמֵיהֶם בַּטּוֹב וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּנְּעִימִים׃
verses.english: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁלַח יַעֲבֹרוּ וְיִגְוְעוּ כִּבְלִי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: But if they do not obey, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.hebrew: וְחַנְפֵי־לֵב יָשִׂימוּ אָף לֹא יְשַׁוְּעוּ כִּי אֲסָרָם׃
verses.english: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they do not cry when he binds them.

verses.hebrew: תָּמֹת בַּנֹּעַר נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם בַּקְּדֵשִׁים׃
verses.english: They die in youth, and their life ends in shame.

verses.hebrew: יְחַלֵּץ עָנִי בְעָנְיוֹ וְיִגֶל בַּלַּחַץ אָזְנָם׃
verses.english: He delivers the poor by means of his affliction, and opens their ears by oppression.

verses.hebrew: וְאַף הֲסִיתְךָ מִפִּי־צָר רַחַב לֹא־מוּצָק תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְנַחַת שֻׁלְחָנְךָ מָלֵא דָשֶׁן׃
verses.english: He has even removed thee out of distress into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which is set on thy table is full of fatness.

verses.hebrew: וְדִין־רָשָׁע מָלֵאתָ דִּין וּמִשְׁפָּט יִתְמֹכוּ׃
verses.english: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֵמָה פֶּן־יְסִיתְךָ בְסָפֶק וְרָב־כֹּפֶר אַל־יַטֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: But beware of wrath, lest he take thee away with his clenched fist: nor let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

verses.hebrew: הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁוּעֲךָ לֹא בְצָר וְכֹל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹחַ׃
verses.english: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, or all the forces of thy strength?

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁאַף הַלָּיְלָה לַעֲלוֹת עַמִּים תַּחְתָּם׃
verses.english: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּפֶן אֶל־אָוֶן כִּי־עַל־זֶה בָּחַרְתָּ מֵעֹנִי׃
verses.english: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ מִי כָמֹהוּ מוֹרֶה׃
verses.english: Behold, God is exalted by his power: who teaches like him?

verses.hebrew: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וּמִי־אָמַר פָּעַלְתָּ עַוְלָה׃
verses.english: Who has enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר כִּי־תַשְׂגִּיא פָעֳלוֹ אֲשֶׁר שֹׁרְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אָדָם חָזוּ־בוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ יַבִּיט מֵרָחוֹק׃
verses.english: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל שַׂגִּיא וְלֹא נֵדָע מִסְפַּר שָׁנָיו וְלֹא־חֵקֶר׃
verses.english: Behold, God is great, and we know it not, nor can the number of his years be searched out.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְגָרַע נִטְפֵי־מָיִם יָזֹקּוּ מָטָר לְאֵדוֹ׃
verses.english: When he draws up small drops of water, they are distilled into a stream of rain;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב׃
verses.english: which the clouds do drop and pour down on man abundantly.

verses.hebrew: אַף אִם־יָבִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָב תְּשֻׁאוֹת סֻכָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Can anyone understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

verses.hebrew: הֵן־פָּרַשׂ עָלָיו אוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁי הַיָּם כִּסָּה׃
verses.english: Behold, he spreads his light about him, and covers the roots of the sea.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָם יָדִין עַמִּים יִתֶּן־אֹכֶל לְמַכְבִּיר׃
verses.english: For by these he judges the peoples; he gives food in abundance.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה־אוֹר וַיְצַו עָלֶיהָ בְמַפְגִּיעַ׃
verses.english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it where it shall strike.

verses.hebrew: יַגִּיד עָלָיו רֵעוֹ מִקְנֶה אַף עַל־עוֹלֶה׃
verses.english: The noise of the storm tells of it; yea the cattle also of the rising tempest.

verses.hebrew: אַף־לְזֹאת יֶחֱרַד לִבִּי וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: At this also my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ בְּרֹגֶז קֹלוֹ וְהֶגֶה מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃
verses.english: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goes out of his mouth.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁרֵהוּ וְאוֹרוֹ עַל־כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He directs it under the whole heaven, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו יִשְׁאַג־קוֹל יַרְעֵם בְּקוֹל גְּאוֹנוֹ וְלֹא יְעַקְּבֵם כִּי־יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלוֹ׃
verses.english: After it a voice roars: he thunders with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

verses.hebrew: יַרְעֵם אֵל בְּקוֹלוֹ נִפְלָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְלֹא נֵדָע׃
verses.english: God thunders marvellously with his voice; great things he does, which we cannot comprehend.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לַשֶּׁלַג יֹאמַר הֱוֵא אָרֶץ וְגֶשֶׁם מָטָר וְגֶשֶׁם מִטְרוֹת עֻזּוֹ׃
verses.english: For he says to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

verses.hebrew: בְּיַד־כָּל־אָדָם יַחְתּוֹם לָדַעַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
verses.english: He seals up the hand of every man; that all men whom He has made may know his work.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא חַיָּה בְמוֹ־אָרֶב וּבִמְעוֹנֹתֶיהָ תִשְׁכֹּן׃
verses.english: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַחֶדֶר תָּבוֹא סוּפָה וּמִמְּזָרִים קָרָה׃
verses.english: Out of the chamber comes the storm: and cold out of the scattering winds.

verses.hebrew: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵל יִתֶּן־קָרַח וְרֹחַב מַיִם בְּמוּצָק׃
verses.english: By the breath of God ice is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

verses.hebrew: אַף־בְּרִי יַטְרִיחַ עָב יָפִיץ עֲנַן אוֹרוֹ׃
verses.english: Also he burdens the thick cloud with an overflow: the cloud scatters lightning:

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא מְסִבּוֹת מִתְהַפֵּךְ בתחבולתו [בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָיו] לְפָעֳלָם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֵּם עַל־פְּנֵי תֵבֵל אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: and it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatever he commands them upon the face of the world, his land.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לְשֵׁבֶט אִם־לְאַרְצוֹ אִם־לְחֶסֶד יַמְצִאֵהוּ׃
verses.english: He causes it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for love.

verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה זֹּאת אִיּוֹב עֲמֹד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵן נִפְלְאוֹת אֵל׃
verses.english: Hearken to this, O Iyyov: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

verses.hebrew: הֲתֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְהוֹפִיעַ אוֹר עֲנָנוֹ׃
verses.english: Dost thou know how God lays his command on them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

verses.hebrew: הֲתֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָב מִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים׃
verses.english: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶיךָ חַמִּים בְּהַשְׁקִט אֶרֶץ מִדָּרוֹם׃
verses.english: Thou whose garments are warm, when the earth is quiet because of the south wind?

verses.hebrew: תַּרְקִיעַ עִמּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִים חֲזָקִים כִּרְאִי מוּצָק׃
verses.english: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong as a molten mirror?

verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּאמַר לוֹ לֹא־נַעֲרֹךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: Teach us what we shall say to him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

verses.hebrew: הַיְסֻפַּר־לוֹ כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אִם־אָמַר אִישׁ כִּי יְבֻלָּע׃
verses.english: Shall it be told him that I would speak? or should a man wish to be swallowed up?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא רָאוּ אוֹר בָּהִיר הוּא בַּשְּׁחָקִים וְרוּחַ עָבְרָה וַתְּטַהֲרֵם׃
verses.english: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passes, and cleanses them.

verses.hebrew: מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֶאֱתֶה עַל־אֱלוֹהַּ נוֹרָא הוֹד׃
verses.english: Gold comes out of the north: about God is terrible majesty.

verses.hebrew: שַׁדַּי לֹא־מְצָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־כֹחַ וּמִשְׁפָּט וְרֹב־צְדָקָה לֹא יְעַנֶּה׃
verses.english: The Almighty, (we cannot find him out:) he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not oppress.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יְרֵאוּהוּ אֲנָשִׁים לֹא־יִרְאֶה כָּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: Men do therefore fear him: he regards not any who are wise of heart.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ הסערה [מִן ] [הַסְּעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then the Lord answered Iyyov out of the storm wind, and said,

verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מַחְשִׁיךְ עֵצָה בְמִלִּין בְּלִי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: Who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

verses.hebrew: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ וְאֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and let me know thy answer.

verses.hebrew: אֵיפֹה הָיִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ בִינָה׃
verses.english: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

verses.hebrew: מִי־שָׂם מְמַדֶּיהָ כִּי תֵדָע אוֹ מִי־נָטָה עָלֶיהָ קָּו׃
verses.english: Who determined its measurements, if thou knowst? or who has stretched the line upon it?

verses.hebrew: עַל־מָה אֲדָנֶיהָ הָטְבָּעוּ אוֹ מִי־יָרָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתָהּ׃
verses.english: whereupon are its foundations fastened? or who laid its corner stone;

verses.hebrew: בְּרָן־יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר וַיָּרִיעוּ כָּל־בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֶךְ בִּדְלָתַיִם יָם בְּגִיחוֹ מֵרֶחֶם יֵצֵא׃
verses.english: or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth, and issued out of the womb?

verses.hebrew: בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבֻשׁוֹ וַעֲרָפֶל חֲתֻלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: when I made the cloud its garment, and thick darkness a swaddling band for it,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁבֹּר עָלָיו חֻקִּי וָאָשִׂים בְּרִיחַ וּדְלָתָיִם׃
verses.english: and prescribed bounds for it, and set bars and doors,

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עַד־פֹּה תָבוֹא וְלֹא תֹסִיף וּפֹא־יָשִׁית בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: and said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

verses.hebrew: הְמִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּיתָ בֹּקֶר ידעתה שחר [יִדַּעְתָּה] [הַשַּׁחַר] מְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began; and caused the dayspring to know its place;

verses.hebrew: לֶאֱחֹז בְּכַנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁעִים מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

verses.hebrew: תִּתְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹמֶר חוֹתָם וְיִתְיַצְּבוּ כְּמוֹ לְבוּשׁ׃
verses.english: It is changed like clay under the seal; and they stand as a garment.

verses.hebrew: וְיִמָּנַע מֵרְשָׁעִים אוֹרָם וּזְרוֹעַ רָמָה תִּשָּׁבֵר׃
verses.english: And from the wicked their light is withheld, and the high arm shall be broken.

verses.hebrew: הֲבָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָם וּבְחֵקֶר תְּהוֹם הִתְהַלָּכְתָּ׃
verses.english: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the recesses of the depth?

verses.hebrew: הֲנִגְלוּ לְךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָוֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵי צַלְמָוֶת תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: have the gates of death been opened to thee? or hast thou seen the doors of deepest darkness?

verses.hebrew: הִתְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃
verses.english: hast thou comprehended the expanse of the earth? declare if thou knowst it all.

verses.hebrew: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־אוֹר וְחֹשֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶה מְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: Where is the way where light dwells? and as for darkness, where is its place,

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִקָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּלוֹ וְכִי־תָבִין נְתִיבוֹת בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: that thou shouldst take it to its bound, and that thou shouldst know the paths to its home?

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אָז תִּוָּלֵד וּמִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ רַבִּים׃
verses.english: Thou knowst it because thou wast then born, and the number of thy days is great.

verses.hebrew: הֲבָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְרוֹת שָׁלֶג וְאֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂכְתִּי לְעֶת־צָר לְיוֹם קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

verses.hebrew: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵחָלֶק אוֹר יָפֵץ קָדִים עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: By what way is the light parted, or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

verses.hebrew: מִי־פִלַּג לַשֶּׁטֶף תְּעָלָה וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃
verses.english: who has divided a watercourse for the torrent of rain, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

verses.hebrew: לְהַמְטִיר עַל־אֶרֶץ לֹא־אִישׁ מִדְבָּר לֹא־אָדָם בּוֹ׃
verses.english: to cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

verses.hebrew: לְהַשְׂבִּיעַ שֹׁאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא דֶשֶׁא׃
verses.english: to satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָר אָב אוֹ מִי־הוֹלִיד אֶגְלֵי־טָל׃
verses.english: Has the rain a father? or who has begotten the drops of dew?

verses.hebrew: מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקָּרַח וּכְפֹר שָׁמַיִם מִי יְלָדוֹ׃
verses.english: out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoar frost of heaven, who has given it birth?

verses.hebrew: כָּאֶבֶן מַיִם יִתְחַבָּאוּ וּפְנֵי תְהוֹם יִתְלַכָּדוּ׃
verses.english: The waters are hidden as with a stone, and the face of the deep forms a solid mass.

verses.hebrew: הַתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה אוֹ־מֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל תְּפַתֵּחַ׃
verses.english: Canst thou bind the chains of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

verses.hebrew: הֲתֹצִיא מַזָּרוֹת בְּעִתּוֹ וְעַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵם׃
verses.english: canst thou bring forth Mazzarot in their season? or canst thou guide the Bear with his sons?

verses.hebrew: הֲיָדַעְתָּ חֻקּוֹת שָׁמָיִם אִם־תָּשִׂים מִשְׁטָרוֹ בָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: knowst thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou establish its dominion in the earth?

verses.hebrew: הֲתָרִים לָעָב קוֹלֶךָ וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

verses.hebrew: הַתְשַׁלַּח בְּרָקִים וְיֵלֵכוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ הִנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say to thee, Here we are?

verses.hebrew: מִי־שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה אוֹ מִי־נָתַן לַשֶּׂכְוִי בִינָה׃
verses.english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? or who has given understanding to the birds?

verses.hebrew: מִי־יְסַפֵּר שְׁחָקִים בְּחָכְמָה וְנִבְלֵי שָׁמַיִם מִי יַשְׁכִּיב׃
verses.english: who can number the clouds by wisdom? or who can refill the bottles of heaven,

verses.hebrew: בְּצֶקֶת עָפָר לַמּוּצָק וּרְגָבִים יְדֻבָּקוּ׃
verses.english: when the dust grows into a mass, and the clods cleave fast together?

verses.hebrew: הֲתָצוּד לְלָבִיא טָרֶף וְחַיַּת כְּפִירִים תְּמַלֵּא׃
verses.english: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָשֹׁחוּ בַמְּעוֹנוֹת יֵשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכָּה לְמוֹ־אָרֶב׃
verses.english: when they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

verses.hebrew: מִי יָכִין לָעֹרֵב צֵידוֹ כִּי־ילדו [יְלָדָיו] אֶל־אֵל יְשַׁוֵּעוּ יִתְעוּ לִבְלִי־אֹכֶל׃
verses.english: Who provides for the raven his provision? when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

verses.hebrew: הֲיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לֶדֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָלַע חֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: Knowst thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

verses.hebrew: תִּסְפֹּר יְרָחִים תְּמַלֶּאנָה וְיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לִדְתָּנָה׃
verses.english: canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowst thou the time when they bring forth?

verses.hebrew: תִּכְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶן תְּפַלַּחְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּחְנָה׃
verses.english: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they send forth their offspring.

verses.hebrew: יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ בַבָּר יָצְאוּ וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Their young ones grow strong; they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not to them.

verses.hebrew: מִי־שִׁלַּח פֶּרֶא חָפְשִׁי וּמֹסְרוֹת עָרוֹד מִי פִתֵּחַ׃
verses.english: Who has sent out the wild ass free? or who has loosed the bands of the onager?

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי עֲרָבָה בֵיתוֹ וּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו מְלֵחָה׃
verses.english: whose house I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwellings.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂחַק לַהֲמוֹן קִרְיָה תְּשֻׁאוֹת נוֹגֵשׂ לֹא יִשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: He scorns the tumult of the city, nor does he regard the shouts of the driver.

verses.hebrew: יְתוּר הָרִים מִרְעֵהוּ וְאַחַר כָּל־יָרוֹק יִדְרוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searches after every green thing.

verses.hebrew: הֲיֹאבֶה רֵּים עָבְדֶךָ אִם־יָלִין עַל־אֲבוּסֶךָ׃
verses.english: Will the wild ox be willing to serve thee, or will he abide by thy crib?

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍תִקְשָׁר־רֵים בְּתֶלֶם עֲבֹתוֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּד עֲמָקִים אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: canst thou bind the wild ox with ropes in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

verses.hebrew: הֲתִבְטַח־בּוֹ כִּי־רַב כֹּחוֹ וְתַעֲזֹב אֵלָיו יְגִיעֶךָ׃
verses.english: wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

verses.hebrew: הֲתַאֲמִין בּוֹ כִּי־ישוב [יָשִׁיב] זַרְעֶךָ וְגָרְנְךָ יֶאֱסֹף׃
verses.english: wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

verses.hebrew: כְּנַף־רְנָנִים נֶעֱלָסָה אִם־אֶבְרָה חֲסִידָה וְנֹצָה׃
verses.english: The wing of the ostrich waves joyously; but are they the pinions and plumage of the stork?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תַעֲזֹב לָאָרֶץ בֵּצֶיהָ וְעַל־עָפָר תְּחַמֵּם׃
verses.english: For she leaves her eggs in the earth, and warms them in dust,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶגֶל תְּזוּרֶהָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּדוּשֶׁהָ׃
verses.english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

verses.hebrew: הִקְשִׁיחַ בָּנֶיהָ לְּלֹא־לָהּ לְרִיק יְגִיעָהּ בְּלִי־פָחַד׃
verses.english: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: though her labour is in vain of yet she is without fear;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשָּׁהּ אֱלוֹהַּ חָכְמָה וְלֹא־חָלַק לָהּ בַּבִּינָה׃
verses.english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, nor has he imparted to her understanding.

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת בַּמָּרוֹם תַּמְרִיא תִּשְׂחַק לַסּוּס וּלְרֹכְבוֹ׃
verses.english: At some time she lifts up herself on high; she scorns the horse and his rider.

verses.hebrew: הֲתִתֵּן לַסּוּס גְּבוּרָה הֲתַלְבִּישׁ צַוָּארוֹ רַעְמָה׃
verses.english: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with power?

verses.hebrew: הְתַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּה הוֹד נַחְרוֹ אֵימָה׃
verses.english: Dost thou make him leap like a locust? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

verses.hebrew: יַחְפְּרוּ בָעֵמֶק וְיָשִׂישׂ בְּכֹחַ יֵצֵא לִקְרַאת־נָשֶׁק׃
verses.english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength: he goes out to meet the battle.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂחַק לְפַחַד וְלֹא יֵחָת וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־חָרֶב׃
verses.english: He mocks at fear, and is not affrighted; nor does he turn back from the sword.

verses.hebrew: עָלָיו תִּרְנֶה אַשְׁפָּה לַהַב חֲנִית וְכִידוֹן׃
verses.english: The quiver rattles against him, the glittering spear and the javelin.

verses.hebrew: בְּרַעַשׁ וְרֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין כִּי־קוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
verses.english: He swallows the ground with fierceness and rage: nor does he believe that it is the sound of the trumpet.

verses.hebrew: בְּדֵי שֹׁפָר יֹאמַר הֶאָח וּמֵרָחוֹק יָרִיחַ מִלְחָמָה רַעַם שָׂרִים וּתְרוּעָה׃
verses.english: He says among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍מִבִּינָתְךָ יַאֲבֶר־נֵץ יִפְרֹשׂ כנפו [כְּנָפָיו] לְתֵימָן׃
verses.english: Does the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings towards the south?

verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־פִּיךָ יַגְבִּיהַּ נָשֶׁר וְכִי יָרִים קִנּוֹ׃
verses.english: does the vulture mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

verses.hebrew: סֶלַע יִשְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָן עַל־שֶׁן־סֶלַע וּמְצוּדָה׃
verses.english: She dwells and abides on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם חָפַר־אֹכֶל לְמֵרָחוֹק עֵינָיו יַבִּיטוּ׃
verses.english: From thence she swoops down on the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

verses.hebrew: ואפרחו [וְאֶפְרֹחָיו] יְעַלְעוּ־דָם וּבַאֲשֶׁר חֲלָלִים שָׁם הוּא׃
verses.english: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then the Lord answered Iyyov, and said,

verses.hebrew: הֲרֹב עִם־שַׁדַּי יִסּוֹר מוֹכִיחַ אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲנֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Shall a reprover contend with the Almighty? he who reproaches God, let him answer it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered the Lord, and said,

verses.hebrew: הֵן קַלֹּתִי מָה אֲשִׁיבֶךָּ יָדִי שַׂמְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִי׃
verses.english: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

verses.hebrew: אַחַת דִּבַּרְתִּי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה וּשְׁתַּיִם וְלֹא אוֹסִיף׃
verses.english: Once I have spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ סערה [מִן ] [סְעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then the Lord answered Iyyov out of the storm wind, and said,

verses.hebrew: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

verses.hebrew: הַאַף תָּפֵר מִשְׁפָּטִי תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּק׃
verses.english: Wilt thou also disavow my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayst be in the right?

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־זְרוֹעַ כָּאֵל לָךְ וּבְקוֹל כָּמֹהוּ תַרְעֵם׃
verses.english: hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

verses.hebrew: עֲדֵה נָא גָאוֹן וָגֹבַהּ וְהוֹד וְהָדָר תִּלְבָּשׁ׃
verses.english: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

verses.hebrew: הָפֵץ עֶבְרוֹת אַפֶּךָ וּרְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold everyone that is proud, and abase him.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּם׃
verses.english: Look on everyone that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

verses.hebrew: טָמְנֵם בֶּעָפָר יָחַד פְּנֵיהֶם חֲבֹשׁ בַּטָּמוּן׃
verses.english: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in the hiding place.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי אוֹדֶךָּ כִּי־תוֹשִׁעַ לְךָ יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: Then I will also confess to thee that thy own right hand can save thee.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא בְהֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּךְ חָצִיר כַּבָּקָר יֹאכֵל׃
verses.english: Behold now behemot, which I made with thee; he eats grass like an ox.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא כֹחוֹ בְמָתְנָיו וְאֹנוֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵי בִטְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Lo now, his might is in his loins, and his force is in the muscles of his belly.

verses.hebrew: יַחְפֹּץ זְנָבוֹ כְמוֹ־אָרֶז גִּידֵי פחדו [פַחֲדָיו] יְשֹׂרָגוּ׃
verses.english: He stiffens his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his thighs are knit together.

verses.hebrew: עֲצָמָיו אֲפִיקֵי נְחוּשָׁה גְּרָמָיו כִּמְטִיל בַּרְזֶל׃
verses.english: His bones are tubes of brass; his limbs are like bars of iron.

verses.hebrew: הוּא רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכֵי־אֵל הָעֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּשׁ חַרְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: He is the beginning of the ways of God: let him that made him bring near his sword to him!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בוּל הָרִים יִשְׂאוּ־לוֹ וְכָל־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה יְשַׂחֲקוּ־שָׁם׃
verses.english: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the wild beasts play.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־צֶאֱלִים יִשְׁכָּב בְּסֵתֶר קָנֶה וּבִצָּה׃
verses.english: He lies under the thorny bushes, in the cover of the reed, and fens.

verses.hebrew: יְסֻכֻּהוּ צֶאֱלִים צִלֲלוֹ יְסֻבּוּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָחַל׃
verses.english: The thorny bushes cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעֲשֹׁק נָהָר לֹא יַחְפּוֹז יִבְטַח כִּי־יָגִיחַ יַרְדֵּן אֶל־פִּיהוּ׃
verses.english: Behold, he drinks up a river, and hastens not: he trusts that river will thrust some food into his mouth.

verses.hebrew: בְּעֵינָיו יִקָּחֶנּוּ בְּמוֹקְשִׁים יִנְקָב־אָף׃
verses.english: Shall anyone take him with his eyes open? or pierce through his nose with a snare?

verses.hebrew: תִּמְשֹׁךְ לִוְיָתָן בְּחַכָּה וּבְחֶבֶל תַּשְׁקִיעַ לְשֹׁנוֹ׃
verses.english: Canst thou draw out livyatan with a hook? or press down his tongue with a cord?

verses.hebrew: הֲתָשִׂים אַגְמוֹן בְּאַפּוֹ וּבְחוֹחַ תִּקּוֹב לֶחֱיוֹ׃
verses.english: canst thou put a hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a bridle ring?

verses.hebrew: הֲיַרְבֶּה אֵלֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִים אִם־יְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַכּוֹת׃
verses.english: will he make many supplications to thee? will he speak soft words to thee?

verses.hebrew: הֲיִכְרֹת בְּרִית עִמָּךְ תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: will he make a covenant with thee? to take him for thy servant for ever?

verses.hebrew: הַתְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ כַּצִּפּוֹר וְתִקְשְׁרֶנּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy girls?

verses.hebrew: יִכְרוּ עָלָיו חַבָּרִים יֶחֱצוּהוּ בֵּין כְּנַעֲנִים׃
verses.english: will the tradesmen heap up payment for him? shall they part him among the merchants?

verses.hebrew: הַתְמַלֵּא בְשֻׂכּוֹת עוֹרוֹ וּבְצִלְצַל דָּגִים רֹאשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

verses.hebrew: שִׂים־עָלָיו כַּפֶּךָ זְכֹר מִלְחָמָה אַל־תּוֹסַף׃
verses.english: Lay thy hand upon him! thou wilt no more think of fighting.

verses.hebrew: הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזָבָה הֲגַם אֶל־מַרְאָיו יֻטָל׃
verses.english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אַכְזָר כִּי יְעוּרֶנּוּ וּמִי הוּא לְפָנַי יִתְיַצָּב׃
verses.english: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

verses.hebrew: מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם לִי־הוּא׃
verses.english: Who has a claim on me from before, that I should repay him? whatever is under the whole heaven is mine.

verses.hebrew: לא־[לוֹ־] אַחֲרִישׁ בַּדָּיו וּדְבַר־גְּבוּרוֹת וְחִין עֶרְכּוֹ׃
verses.english: I will hold my peace at him; listen to his words, the report of his power, and his graceful speech.

verses.hebrew: מִי־גִלָּה פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנוֹ מִי יָבוֹא׃
verses.english: Who can uncover the face of his garment? or who can come within his double bridle?

verses.hebrew: דַּלְתֵי פָנָיו מִי פִתֵּחַ סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו אֵימָה׃
verses.english: who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

verses.hebrew: גַּאֲוָה אֲפִיקֵי מָגִנִּים סָגוּר חוֹתָם צָר׃
verses.english: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal:

verses.hebrew: אֶחָד בְּאֶחָד יִגַּשׁוּ וְרוּחַ לֹא־יָבוֹא בֵינֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: one is so near to another, that no air can come between them:

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיהוּ יְדֻבָּקוּ יִתְלַכְּדוּ וְלֹא יִתְפָּרָדוּ׃
verses.english: they are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

verses.hebrew: עֲ‍טִישֹׁתָיו תָּהֶל אוֹר וְעֵינָיו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר׃
verses.english: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.hebrew: מִפִּיו לַפִּידִים יַהֲלֹכוּ כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ יִתְמַלָּטוּ׃
verses.english: Out of his mouth go burning torches, and sparks of fire leap out.

verses.hebrew: מִנְּחִירָיו יֵצֵא עָשָׁן כְּדוּד נָפוּחַ וְאַגְמֹן׃
verses.english: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot and burning rushes.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט וְלַהַב מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃
verses.english: His breath kindles coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

verses.hebrew: בְּצַוָּארוֹ יָלִין עֹז וּלְפָנָיו תָּדוּץ דְּאָבָה׃
verses.english: In his neck abides strength, and terror dances before him.

verses.hebrew: מַפְּלֵי בְשָׂרוֹ דָבֵקוּ יָצוּק עָלָיו בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃
verses.english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.

verses.hebrew: לִבּוֹ יָצוּק כְּמוֹ־אָבֶן וְיָצוּק כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּית׃
verses.english: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as the nether millstone.

verses.hebrew: מִשֵּׂתוֹ יָגוּרוּ אֵלִים מִשְּׁבָרִים יִתְחַטָּאוּ׃
verses.english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid: by reason of the crashings they are beside themselves.

verses.hebrew: מַשִּׂיגֵהוּ חֶרֶב בְּלִי תָקוּם חֲנִית מַסָּע וְשִׁרְיָה׃
verses.english: Though the sword reaches him, it does not avail; nor the spear, the dart, or the javelin.

verses.hebrew: יַחְשֹׁב לְתֶבֶן בַּרְזֶל לְעֵץ רִקָּבוֹן נְחוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: He esteems iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ בֶן־קָשֶׁת לְקַשׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־לוֹ אַבְנֵי־קָלַע׃
verses.english: the arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble:

verses.hebrew: כְּקַשׁ נֶחְשְׁבוּ תוֹתָח וְיִשְׂחַק לְרַעַשׁ כִּידוֹן׃
verses.english: darts are counted as stubble; he laughs at the shaking of a spear.

verses.hebrew: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶשׂ יִרְפַּד חָרוּץ עֲלֵי־טִיט׃
verses.english: His underparts are like sharp potsherds: he spreads himself like a threshing sledge on the mire.

verses.hebrew: יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסִּיר מְצוּלָה יָם יָשִׂים כַּמֶּרְקָחָה׃
verses.english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot: he makes the sea like a kettle.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר נָתִיב יַחְשֹׁב תְּהוֹם לְשֵׂיבָה׃
verses.english: After him he leaves a shining wake; one would think the deep to be hoary.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־עַל־עָפָר מָשְׁלוֹ הֶעָשׂוּ לִבְלִי־חָת׃
verses.english: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

verses.hebrew: אֵת־כָּל־גָּבֹהַּ יִרְאֶה הוּא מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־בְּנֵי־שָׁחַץ׃
verses.english: He beholds all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃
verses.english: Then Iyyov answered the Lord, and said,

verses.hebrew: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־כֹל תּוּכָל וְלֹא־יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה׃
verses.english: I know that Thou canst do everything, and that no purpose of Thine can be thwarted.

verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מַעְלִים עֵצָה בְּלִי דָעַת לָכֵן הִגַּדְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין נִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא אֵדָע׃
verses.english: Who is he that hides counsel without knowledge? therefore I have uttered that which I did not understand; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־נָא וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Hear, I beseech Thee, and I will speak: I will demand of Thee, and declare Thou unto me.

verses.hebrew: לְשֵׁמַע־אֹזֶן שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ וְעַתָּה עֵינִי רָאָתְךָ׃
verses.english: I have heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear: but now my eye sees Thee.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אֶמְאַס וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל־עָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃
verses.english: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי חָרָה אַפִּי בְךָ וּבִשְׁנֵי רֵעֶיךָ כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃
verses.english: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words to Iyyov, the Lord said to Elifaz the Temanite; My anger burns against thee, and against thy two friends: for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, like my servant Iyyov.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה־פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים וּלְכוּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶם עוֹלָה בַּעַדְכֶם וְאִיּוֹב עַבְדִּי יִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיכֶם כִּי אִם־פָּנָיו אֶשָּׂא לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם נְבָלָה כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃
verses.english: Therefore take for yourselves now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Iyyov, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Iyyov shall pray for you: for to him I will show favour in doing you no disgrace, although you have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Iyyov.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוָה וַיִּשָּׂא יְהוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי אִיּוֹב׃
verses.english: So Elifaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuĥite and Żofar the Na῾amatite went, and did as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Iyyov.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה שָׁב אֶת־שבית [שְׁבוּת] אִיּוֹב בְּהִתְפַּלְלוֹ בְּעַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לְאִיּוֹב לְמִשְׁנֶה׃
verses.english: And the Lord restored the fortunes of Iyyov, when he prayed for his friends: and the Lord gave Iyyov twice as much as he had before.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־אֶחָיו וְכָל־אחיתיו [אַחְיוֹתָיו] וְכָל־יֹדְעָיו לְפָנִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ עִמּוֹ לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיָּנֻדוּ לוֹ וַיְנַחֲמוּ אֹתוֹ עַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא יְהוָה עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ אִישׁ קְשִׂיטָה אֶחָת וְאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Then all his brothers came to him, and all his sisters, and all they who had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a qesita, and everyone an earring of gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת־אַחֲרִית אִיּוֹב מֵרֵאשִׁתוֹ וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף צֹאן וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וְאֶלֶף־צֶמֶד בָּקָר וְאֶלֶף אֲתוֹנוֹת׃
verses.english: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Iyyov more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שִׁבְעָנָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת׃
verses.english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם־הָאַחַת יְמִימָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית קְצִיעָה וְשֵׁם הַשְּׁלִישִׁית קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ׃
verses.english: And he called the name of the first, Yemima; and the name of the second, Qeżi῾a; and the name of the third, Qeren-happukh.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נִמְצָא נָשִׁים יָפוֹת כִּבְנוֹת אִיּוֹב בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Iyyov: and their father gave them inheritance among their brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אִיּוֹב אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת מֵאָה וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וירא [וַיִּרְאֶה] אֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֵי בָנָיו אַרְבָּעָה דֹּרוֹת׃
verses.english: After this Iyyov lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אִיּוֹב זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים׃
verses.english: So Iyyov died, being old and full of days.
